game is not difficult! Drag the rope to make a safe path, control the rope, and rescue everyone.Don't forget to avoid the obstacles along the way. If you play Rope Puzzle, make sure you do nothing. You will play for hours and linger.

title: Wood Blocks Jam
description:
Wood Blocks Jam is a relaxing logic puzzle game with colorful wooden blocks. Your goal is to drag each block into a gate of the same color. No time limits — just calm, thoughtful gameplay.

Enjoy thousands of handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty and new mechanics to discover.

title: Bubble Shooter Pro 4
description: Get ready for Bubble Shooter Pro 4, the ultimate bubble-popping adventure! The latest sequel introduces exciting new features: the explosive Bomb and Firebomb to pop multiple bubbles at once, Bonus Gifts, and collecting Stars to complete Missions. Customize your gameplay with new Props, Frames, and Hats. Dive into the action and enjoy hours of strategic bubble shooting with these thrilling updates!

title: Find the Ghost Cat
description: Your mission is to track down elusive ghost cats! These sneaky felines are masters of camouflage, blending into their surroundings, fading into transparency, or hiding in shadows. Stay sharp and see if you can find them all!

title: Racing Ball Adventure
description:
Race down massive slopes at high speed through stunning green plains, cliffs, and canyons!
In this thrilling arcade adventure, collect the mystical Crystal to save the world from an impending disaster.
Grab your sphere and start your journey — an epic low-poly adventure awaits!

title: Lambo Traffic Racer
description: Lambo Traffic Racing, you will be playing lambo cars through endless highway. It is a great game for kids and adults. Great fun, great graphics and great lambos to drive .

title: Shape Transform Blob Racing
description: Shape Transform: Blob Racing is a casual running game. In this game, you will control a little Blob, running, shape-shifting, and go through various challenges! It would help if you quickly switched the Blob’s shape while running to navigate various obstacles. For example, turning into a ball helps you roll through narrow passages. When you become a square, it helps you cross flat areas more  easily.

title: Block Puzzle Cats
description: Train your brain and solve puzzles with cute cats! Drag and drop the cats onto the puzzle board and try to put them all together! Unique puzzle shapes and ever-changing challenges will train your brain to think in a whole new way. Can you fit all the cats in? Collect cute new cats as you beat each puzzle challenge.Now come and join the fun and challenging game world.

title: Sprunki Challenge
description: Sprunki Challenge game adds a challenge mode to the famous Sprunki game and activates the game's battle mode. While the 1 Player mode of the game includes the classic mode, in the 2 Player mode you both make music using Sprunki characters and try to reach 2000 by generating scores. You can play the game with your friend in both dark mode and normal mode. If you want, you can also activate different backgrounds.

title: sprunki clicker & merge phase 3
description: Sprunki Clicker & Merge: Phase 3 is an exciting rhythm-based idle game where you tap to earn money and unlock new Sprunki creatures! Each Sprunki has a unique musical beat, and as you merge them, you create richer, more dynamic melodies. Grow your collection, upgrade your beats, and become the ultimate Sprunki maestro!

title: Skip Love
description: Ready for a funny, brain-teasing love adventure? Play an addictive brain teaser puzzle game in Skip Love. A funny little stickman hero trying to win the heart of his beloved while dodging all sorts of dangers! Each level has unique puzzles that make you think and laugh! Think and use your brain to overcome each challenge, helping the man overcome his sexy wife and lover. For example, help him disguise himself as a clown, disrupt, create chaos, etc.

title: Back 2 School Makeover
description: Embrace the nostalgia and dive into our Back 2 School Makeover game, where you can fashionably express yourself, experiment with stunning looks, and relish into the feeling of heading back to school with style! Embark on a fabulous journey with our character, Amelia, as she transforms from an edgy e-girl to a chic, school-ready fashionista. Revamp her entire look starting with a haircare routine and a new haircut, a complete skincare routine, and a new, school makeup.

title: Knife Up 3D
description: Knife Up 3D is a casual game that tests your reflexes. Feel the rhythm, don't damage the ball and beat your opponents. You can unlock new skins with the rewards you get by passing the levels. It's time to test your reflexes, so if you find it interesting, don't forget to share it with your friends and join in! Have fun!

title: Sorting Balls
description: Sorting Balls is a fun and challenging puzzle game where players must sort colored balls into the correct tubes. The goal is to organize all the balls by color using logical thinking and strategic moves. As the levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring careful planning. With simple controls and engaging mechanics, Sorting Balls is perfect for players who enjoy brain-teasing challenges.

title: Happy Monsters 2
description:
A bundle of fun games designed for children of all ages that will delight everyone!

Our little monsters love to play all sorts of games where you collect coins. Help them gather as many as possible to unlock all the toys. Complete the entire toy collection!

title: Iconic Halloween Costumes
description: Get ready for a spooky and stylish adventure in Iconic Halloween Costumes! Help three BFFs pick out their perfect Halloween looks, from royal Glinda and Bridgerton-inspired outfits to edgy Beetlejuice vibes and cowgirl-chic styles. Customize their costumes with tops, bottoms, accessories, and makeup to create iconic Halloween outfits. Play now and let the fashion fun begin!

title: Huggy Wuggy Escape
description: Huggy Wuggy Escape is a Poppy Playtime inspired fangame where you have to do 4 simple things in order to win: Find a gun, find some bullets, shoot down Huggy Wuggy and leave the factory before it explode. To kill Huggy you have to shoot him at least six times, but the bullets are rare, so you have to move around the complex looking for them. If Huggy catch you is game over. Once you shot him down, you have to reach the exit in less than 30 seconds.

title: Logic Blast Explorer
description: A fresh twist on the classic block puzzle experience, featuring hundreds of handcrafted levels, relaxing yet strategic gameplay, world landmarks to collect, boosters and custom tile skins.

title: Hide And Seek Horror Escape
description: Hide And Seek: Horror Escape is an asymmetric horror escape game. Abandoned schools and haunted hospitals, here's a lot of hidden secrets and treasures are waiting to be discovered. During the game, there are two identities for you to choose, hide or seek?

title: Chill Girl Clicker
description: Chill Girl Clicker is a soothing, laid-back clicker game that’s perfect for unwinding and finding your zen. Just like its predecessor, Chill Girl Clicker, this game offers a serene and calming experience, but with a delightful twist: a charming girl as the main character, bringing a fresh and enchanting vibe to your screen.

title: Capybara Screw Jam
description: Welcome to Capybara Screw Jam! This is a cute and brain-teasing puzzle game. You’ll join a lovable capybara on a journey of problem-solving and strategy. With simple gameplay and increasing challenges, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves casual puzzles and brain workouts. Your goal is to help the capybara solve various puzzle challenges. Each level presents various colors of capybara.

title: Obby Rescue Mission
description: Obby rescue mission is a free online game, a set of missions and levels of this game will test your ability to aim and shoot in fast motion to eliminate all the targets in each level. Little Obby is on a rescue mission of citizens captured by a gang of gangsters in the city and your goal is to rescue and eliminate all these enemies that are in your way.

title: Plant Merge: Zombie War
description: In the chaotic world of Merge Plant Zombie War, arm your garden with strategic merges to fend off relentless zombie hordes! Master upgrades, deploy special abilities, and outsmart waves of undead foes in this addictive merge-tower defense adventure. Will your botanical army prevail in the ultimate war for survival? Dive in and merge your way to victory!

title: Bow And Arrow
description:
? Bow and Arrow – Master Your Archery Skills! ?

Step into the world of precision shooting in Bow and Arrow! Test your skills, aim with accuracy, and hit your targets in a variety of exciting levels. Whether you're shooting at moving targets, battling enemies, or competing in archery challenges, this game will put your skills to the test!

title: Uphill Rush 13
description: Introducing the new, thirteenth game in the Uphill Rush series, and this time in a new setting - a Water Park! Dive into (pun intended) the atmosphere of water fun, riding different types of tubes, surfboards and even jet skis! Unlock new power-ups and skins by overcoming obstacles, such as loops and long jumps. But don't be scared of them, they are your best friends when it comes to stunts, which give you bonuses! Not to mention, make you look insanely cool.

title: Gold Miner Classic
description: Jump into the most classic gold mining adventure ever! Gold Miner Classic brings you all the excitement of being a real gold miner. Feel into the perfect casual relaxation experience. Your mission is simple but incredibly satisfying.

title: Carnage Battle Arena
description:
Get Carnage now and discover a new kind of racing game! Driving fast and getting to the finish line is only one of the multiple challenges that await you. Wreak havoc on the streets thanks to the extensive destruction model that lets you not only damage vehicles, but also cause visible changes in the environment. After a long battle, the location will look nothing like it used to at the start!

Whichever mode you choose, get ready for loads of adrenaline-pumping action! Play Carnage now!

title: Winter Maze
description:
Step into a frosty puzzle adventure with Winter Maze! Explore icy, snow-covered mazes and guide your ball through slippery, twisty paths that fill up with every move. Each level challenges you to think ahead, plan your route and clear the entire field to unlock the next stage.
Simply swipe to roll the ball in any direction and watch the maze come to life beneath you. Your goal is clear: cover every tile and leave no space untouched.

title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
description: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck. But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks!

title: Hidden Objects Bakery
description: Explore 6 charming bakery shops in this fun hidden object game! With 24 exciting levels, find 6 hidden bakery items in each shop before time runs out. Perfect for all ages, enjoy the challenge and discover delicious treats in every corner. Can you find them all before time runs out?

title: Tarcat
description:
Enter the world of feline destruction with Tarcat, a hilarious casual game where you control a cats paw! Your goal? Smash all targets with quick reflexes and pinpoint accuracy!

With just one tap, hit targets, avoid traps, and dominate each level with the style of a true feline destroyer.

title: Count Master Match Color Run
description: Count Master: Match Color Run is a colorful running game where you lead a group of little characters in a color-matching race! In this exciting arcade challenge, collect characters of the same color to grow your team. Merge them for a bigger squad, aiming for the highest score. Avoid hammers, spikes, etc. Collect characters of the same color to expand your team.

title: Puzzle Box Brain Fun
description: Puzzle Box - Brain Fun is a brain game containing multiple modes. Different levels of difficulty and gameplay are waiting for you to unlock! Challenge your intelligence while enjoying casual games! Come and challenge Puzzle Box - Brain Fun to test your IQ and play with your brain! Start when you are ready and show your strength!

title: Farm: Merge Harvest
description: Transform your land into a beautiful farming haven. Start with a small plot and grow it by merging crops, designing structures and unlocking new areas. The more you build, the more surprises await, bringing new rewards and adventures at every stage!

title: Pop Them!
description:
Link 3 or more emojis of the same color!
Link them in any direction to connect them all!
Reach the goal within the limited number of moves
Pop the bubbles around the boxes or evil emojis to destroy them
Use power-ups to accomplish your mission!

title: Traffic Tap Puzzle
description: Traffic Tap Puzzle is a challenging puzzle game where players must control traffic at intersections by tapping on cars to start or stop them. The goal is to avoid collisions while ensuring a smooth flow of vehicles. As the levels progress, traffic becomes more complex, requiring strategic timing and quick decision-making. With engaging mechanics and increasing difficulty, the game tests your reflexes and planning skills.

title: Magic Printer
description: This is a simulation game, you play a shop assistant, for the small animals to print the goods they need, then you will get gold, gold can be used to decorate your shop, upgrade your equipment, this game is very good, come and play.

title: Skibidi Toilet vs Cameraman Sniper Game
description: Camera man are trying to survive in toilet mans red light green light game. If there is a camera man moving when the toilet man says red light, you must destroy him with your sniper gun. When aiming, you have to make sure you hit the right player. If you shoot the correct player, you earn additional points. Compete with your friends by getting the highest score. Play Toilet vs Cameraman Sniper now!

title: Brawl Stars
description: Welcome to a multiplayer arena game! Brawl Stars will take you into a world full of action .io battles! You will experience nervous PVP battles and a unique evolution system. Choose your favorite hero including fire dragons, electric dogs or flower spirits.

title: Color Brain Test Games
description: Color Brain Test Game is a ring puzzle game. Do you want to train your brain?  You love fun spinning circle puzzle games with simple and colorful gameplay. Play Color Brain Test Games now!

title: Cars with Guns: Wasteland Showdown
description:
Accept the challenge of the post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take on contracts, earn money and reputation, and collect valuable loot.
Survival belongs to those with the fastest ride and the biggest gun.

title: Microplastics Feeding
description: Microplastics Feeding is a game about a hungry fish who is looking for its favorite food: plastic! Help the fish to eat all the plastic things in the ocean!

title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.
Be the hero the world needs!
Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

title: Eye Attack - Toilet Monster War
description:
Help Secret Agent to survive in Toilet War! Solve puzzles and prevent toilet invasion in our world!

Every single level in Eye Attack: Toilet Monster War is an unique challenge that will train your logic and shooting skills. Only the smartest players can solve all the puzzles and destroy all the Toilet Monsters on the level. Try to get three stars on each level! Can you?

Try this Trending Toilet Monster game and join the fight against the Toilet Monsters!

title: Fashion Famous
description: Step into the stylish universe of Fashion Famous! Compete in glamorous fashion contests, pick outfits that match each round’s theme, and impress the judges to earn high scores. Travel across global fashion capitals and showcase your look on dazzling runways. Explore makeup, hairstyles, and accessories to build the perfect outfit. Will your sense of style stand out among players from all around the world?

title: Bubble Plopper
description: In Bubble Plopper you can either try to prevent the bubbles from filling the playfield in Classic mode or try to clear the playfield within the given time in Time attack mode. Shooting bubbles has never been so fun. Plop plop!

title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
description: "Hyper Cars Ramp Crash" is a 3D stunt and crash simulation game with realistic physics and graphics. You can perform incredible stunts in many different modes with great looking cars. 7 different super-sport car models are waiting in the garage for you to try them. Open world, stunt modes and fall mode can be played in 1-player and 2-player modes.

title: Bublix: Bubble Hit
description: Bublix: Bubble Hit is a fast-paced bubble shooter where precision and strategy matter. Aim, shoot, and match 3 or more bubbles to clear the board. Use clever angles, wall bounces, and combos to boost your score. With endless gameplay and rising difficulty, it’s perfect for quick, addictive sessions.

title: Math Obby
description: Combine your math skills with parkour prowess in Math Obby, an engaging Roblox experience that challenges players with arithmetic problems amidst obstacle courses. Navigate through stages that test both your agility and your knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Earn badges as you progress and showcase your mastery in this educational adventure.

title: Musketeers Gunpowder vs Steel
description: Take command in Musketeers: Gunpowder vs Steel, a strategic 17th-century battle experience. Lead musketeers, pikemen, and reiters as a mercenary commander, issuing orders, engaging in combat, and training troops. Master tactics, crush your enemies, and claim victory on the battlefield.

title: Vex X3M 3
description: VEX X3M 3 is here! The most intense Vex hill racing experience yet. Race through new levels filled with traps, sand, electricity, and unpredictable terrain that test your timing and skill. Ride through pipes, master new physics, and take on hard mode or a CPU opponent. Unlock powerful bikes, beat every track, and prove you’re a true VEX X3M rider. Start your engine and take on the challenge!

title: Murder Mystery
description: Murder Mystery – A fast-paced social deduction game. One player is the killer, another the sheriff, the rest are innocents. Use logic, stealth, and quick decisions to survive or expose the murderer. Perfect for high engagement and multiplayer retention.

title: Sneaker Factory!
description: Manage your own sneaker factory in this fast-paced online game! Complete orders, organize sneakers, deliver shipments, and rise through the ranks. Put your speed, strategy, and management skills to the test to become the city’s leading factory!

title: Mystical Blade 3D
description: Enter the world of Mystical Blades, where you design and battle your own B-Blades! Mix blades, rings, and elements to create powerful combos, then face players worldwide in thrilling battles. With stunning graphics and realistic physics, prove your skills and become the ultimate B-Blades master!

title: Brainstorming 2D
description: Brainstorming 2D is a puzzle game. In each slider puzzle, you will see a grid with colored grid edges with squares inside these borders. The squares are the same color as the grid edges. The number of colors may vary. Each slider puzzle aims to get rid of all blocks locked within the edges of the grid.

title: Parking Driver
description: Ever struggled to find a parking spot? In "Parking Driver," you'll face tricky parking challenges! From tight parallel parking to complex reverse maneuvers, you need precise control to avoid obstacles and park perfectly in the shortest time. The game features a realistic physics engine and diverse level designs, each testing your patience and skill. Come prove your driving prowess, unlock cool new cars, and conquer every parking lot!

title: Put the fruit together!
description: A game in the genre of "Connect the Balls" and "2048". Stack identical fruits to combine them into a new larger fruit! The game has incredibly beautiful and cute graphics, nice music accompaniment and addictive gameplay!

title: Woodland Slide
description:
Embark on a relaxing journey in Woodland Slide! Slide the colorful jewels across wooden planks to create perfect matches and clear the board.

With every move, a new row of gems disappears, adding to the challenge. Use your strategy and unlock powerful abilities to remove gems, split them into smaller pieces, or clear entire rows.

Explore a serene, nature-inspired setting while testing your puzzle-solving skills. How far can you go in this addictive quest for the perfect match?

title: Pushover 3D
description: Unleash your creativity in *Pushover 3D*! Draw unique curves to control your ragdoll fighter’s moves, launching them in unexpected ways to defeat opponents. Each match is a wild, physics-based showdown where every line transforms into unpredictable body motions. From wild spins to slingshot leaps, it’s all up to the patterns you create. Experiment, outsmart your rivals, and become a master of ragdoll combat!

title: Loop Survivors Zombie City
description: A fast-paced action-survival game where you fight zombies and mutants, upgrade your city and character, collect weapons and armor. Build your shelter, unlock random perks, and become the ultimate survivor!

title: Space Raider
description: Blast your way through the galaxy in intense battles. Enjoy beautiful graphic and exciting gameplay with tons of enemies as customizable ships.

title: Basket Shot
description: Anyone may enjoy the swelteringly popular arcade game Basket Shot! Become the next basketball superstar by shooting baskets and unlocking new balls!

title: My Dinosaur Land
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of "My Dinosaur Land"! This is an exciting game where you will become the owner of a unique farm filled with dinosaurs! Your task is to transform an ordinary farm into a real dinosaur paradise, taking care of funny and exciting creatures of prehistoric times.

title: Meow Block: Color Collect!
description: A burst of color, clever thinking, and adorable cats await you in Meow Block: Color Collect! This charming puzzle experience turns simple movements into brain-teasing fun, where every swipe matters and every match brings you closer to victory.

title: Uncle Bullet 007
description:
Play as Uncle Bullet, a retired spy who’s back in the game to take down rival agents and save the day. Armed with an arsenal of bouncy bullets, you’ll use your wits and quick reflexes to outmaneuver foes and rescue hostages.

Shoot your bullets at walls, ceilings, and floors to make them bounce, ricochet, and curve around corners to hit your targets.

title: Spring Tile Master
description: Welcome to Spring Tile Master! Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of spring as you match tiles adorned with blooming flowers, colorful leaves, and charming insects. Draw tiles from the board to form sets of three. Keep up to 9 tiles in your stack and shuffle when needed. Collect all tiles to unlock new levels. Enjoy the enchanting springtime adventure and become the ultimate Spring Tile Master!

title: Jailbreak Assault
description: In Jailbreak Assault, you’re a prisoner on a daring escape mission. Starting in your cell, you grab a key dropped by a guard, unlock the door, and arm yourself with a baton. Battle guards, destroy vital documents, disable cameras, and unlock new areas as you fight your way through each mission. Eventually, you’ll secure a gun from the armory, using it to take on the heavily guarded outer perimeter. Can you make it to freedom?

title: Unblock Ball Slide Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Unblock Ball: Slide Puzzle, a classic sliding puzzle game that lets you use your mind.You can feel a sense of accomplishment! Sliding the board to create the channel for the ball to roll smoothly to the end. You should use your logical mind to cleverly move blocks, avoid
obstacles, and solve every puzzle!

title: Kung-Fu Little Animals
description: In this game you will become the new assistant of the Great Master. Your task is to teach funny and dexterous animals the art of kung fu. With simple clicks, you will train your newly minted students so that they become worthy successors of the Great Master's work. Passing the game, you will discover new funny animals, as well as new beautiful and unusual locations. Join the kung fu team and have fun teaching the little animals martial arts!

title: Stick Hero Fight
description: Enter the most nervous stickman battles. In Stick Hero Fight, you as a mighty stickman hero. Fight through waves of enemies using incredible battle skills. This action game lets you upgrade your hero and unleash devastating attacks to dominate every fight! Use punches, weapons, and powerful skills to deliver deadly attacks.

title: Monster School 2
description: Monsters from minecraft are trained at the monster school by Herobrin's teacher. Take the tests, find out who is a Noob and who is a real pro in Bottle Flip challenge, parkour and roller coaster!

title: Mr Throw
description: Mr Throw is a game in which even an old teddy bear can become a deadly weapon! Calculate the strength and direction of the throw and throw at the enemy all the things that come to hand! Victory in this dangerous garbage battle!

title: Quiz 10 Seconds Math
description: Quiz 10 Seconds Math is a fun, fast-paced educational game that challenges your mental math skills! Race against the clock to solve addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division problems—each level gets harder as you progress. With only 10 seconds per question, every decision counts. Track your best score, compete with yourself, and boost your brainpower anytime, anywhere. Perfect for students, teachers, and math lovers who want to learn while playing! , no distractions

title: Pixel Art
description: With pixel art, paint cubes with the right colors and create pixel art. the right colors and cubes are waiting for you to paint

title: Dot by Dot
description:
Dot By Dot is a relaxing puzzle game where you have to connect dots into lines and get amazing drawings. Once you connect all the dots and lines, the drawing will be automatically colored! Enjoy the addictive puzzle game!
Let the Dot by Dot game develop your creativity and skills. Draw a line, connect colored dots and see what kind of drawing you get.

title: Super Bitcoin Boy
description: “Super Bitcoin Boy” is a “Mario Bros” style platform game, themed around the Bitcoin cryptocurrency, eliminate enemies, overcome obstacles, collect all the bitcoins to get the highest score possible. Enjoy the Halving year, have fun playing and complete all levels.

title: Obby: Pogo Parkour!
description: Obby: Pogo Parkour! is a dynamic arcade game where you control a character on a pogo stick, overcoming various levels filled with obstacles. Buy and upgrade your pogo sticks to complete challenges faster and more efficiently. Compete with players from all around the world and aim for the top of the leaderboard. Dive into the thrilling world of parkour on a pogo stick and test your reflexes in Obby: Pogo Parkour!

title: Spider-Noob obstacle course
description:
Noob was bitten by a creeper-spider and became a spider-noob! Help Noob train in the big city, fly on webs, collect badges, unlock new costumes, and complete challenges. Unlock new levels. 

Complete all the levels and turn Noob into a Pro-spider

title: Mini Springs
description: Mini Springs is a retro-style platform game where you command a small blob character that can't jump; use the springs all over the stage to evade obstacles and reach your goal!

title: Animal Swipe
description: Animal Swipe is a fun and addictive puzzle game where players match adorable animal pairs on a colorful board. With easy-to-learn controls and exciting power-ups, the game offers a challenge for both casual and strategic players. Use your wits and boosts to clear levels and achieve your objectives!

title: Merge Brainrot 2
description:
Drop and merge the new  Italian Brainrot memes!
From "Bobrito Bandito" to "Špijuniro Golubiro" and "Burbaloni Lulilolli", they’re all here.
What final Brainrot will you unlock? Dare to find out!

title: Dead Paradise
description: Dead Paradise: Race Shooter is an apocalyptic car game where you drive, shoot enemies, and try to survive until the finish. Completing levels gives you coins to upgrade your car’s missiles, armor, engine, and fuel. You can also buy new vehicles, take missions, and complete daily tasks for extra rewards. Use your resources wisely to make your car stronger and improve your chances of survival.

title: Army Truck Driver Online
description: Take control of a cargo army truck in a military game and deliver high-ranking soldiers to their camp. Carrying out your assignment as an army truck driver cargo in this military game is no easy feat, especially when you're an officer. The highways are filled with hazards and obstacles.

title: Roof Car Stunt
description: Challenging car game where you drive and collect coins. Jump around ramps, drive through various obstacles and drive into a giant pink donut to complete the level!

title: BlockPuzzle : Color Blast
description:
"Block Puzzle" is a fun and classic block game!
And our Block Puzzle is not just that. It is more Simple and addictive! Once you start, you will not stop playing. Just have a try, you will love it!

title: Apple Worm
description: Play Apple Worm now. This is a classic puzzle game with simple operation. Brain-burning levels make you love it! Control a cute little worm whose goal is to eat the apple and upgrade. Upgrading allows you to unlock more cute skins. You can also earn rewards by completing challenges. Unlock Auto ATK, Summoning, etc. Enter the snakey mode. Control your worm and eat the apples. Go through the obstacles and enter the portal without any problems!

title: Eastern Star vs City Style Icon
description: Welcome to the world of style, where the ancient palaces of the East meet the splendor of a modern metropolis! Two beautiful heroines are waiting for you in the game: an oriental beauty with exquisite outfits in the style of an Ottoman fairy tale and a stylish urban fashionista conquering the catwalks of the metropolis. During the game, you will become a fashion stylist and create unique looks for each of the girls. Choose your side in the cultural dispute and make this choice a reality!

title: Jelly Block Puzzle
description: Dive into the fun with our vibrant jelly merging game! Explore a world filled with countless levels, merge jellies, use power-ups, and stay entertained. Challenge your brain and see how far you can go in this delightful, jelly-colored adventure!

title: Lost in the Forest
description:
Lost in the forest is a classic adventure game. The protagonist is an airman who ends up in a storm, loses control of his plane and falls into a mysterious forest.
The next day is stuck under a tree and must find a way to break free and solve various puzzles to make it back home safely.

title: Soccer Dash
description:
Soccer dash is a soccer game in which you swipe a soccer ball through obstacles and soccer players and hit the ball to score a goal.

You have drag controls, drag to choose the direction of the kick, and release to hit the ball. During the dragging process, the game goes into a slow motion state, so you can take your time to choose the direction of the kick.

title: Pet Runner
description: Pet Runner is a fast-paced platformer where your pet runs forward automatically, and you must jump, dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect coins. Play in Endless Mode for infinite fun or tackle unique challenges in Level Mode. Use up to three lives, hit checkpoints, and complete daily challenges to earn coins. Unlock and customize adorable pets in the shop to enhance your adventure. With its exciting gameplay and charming rewards, Pet Runner offers fun for all ages!

title: Hydraulic Press 2D ASMR
description: You have in your hands a terrifying power that gives you the ability to grind dozens of objects! A very effective stress reliever. Try out your personal hydraulic press right now and start destroying all objects! Crush, crush, break!

title: Fishing Bear
description:
Tap to reel in your fishing line and catch as many fish as you can!
But stay alert—mischievous creatures in the sea will try to get in your way.
And when you pick up a mysterious Treasure Shell… something exciting might happen!
Enjoy a simple and addictive fishing experience!

title: Block Blast 2048
description: Block Blast 2048 is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you merge blocks with the same number to create higher values. Keep merging to boost your score and face increasing challenges. How far can you go? Can you reach the ultimate block? Play now and test your puzzle skills!

title: Tower Defenders
description: Fight the undead viking warriors and upgrade your defenses. Use the rewards you get for victories to your advantage. Hold out for as long as you can!

title: 3D Maze Control
description: 3D Maze Control is a casual and fun puzzle physics game. Your goal is to rotate the board to let the ball reach its goal. The ball always falls down due to gravity and beware of scary aliens on the way.

title: Guess The Italian Brainrot Animals
description: Get ready for a wild and hilarious ride with Guess the Italian Brainrot Animals, a fast-paced, emoji-fueled trivia game that tests your knowledge of 64 iconic Italian Brainrot characters! description:
An educational and exciting game in which you can test your logical and strategic thinking.
Solve unique puzzles to while away the time and relax with excellent soundtrack. A bright and exciting game is perfect not only for children, but will also give you the opportunity to test your skills in solving difficult problems for adults.

title: Riders Downhill Racing
description: Get ready to join the riders in an exciting adventure with Riders Downhill Racing! Choose from various game modes, including free ride, race, and career, available in both 1 player and 2 player modes. Experience the thrill of riding different vehicles, such as ATV bikes, cross bikes, and speed boats, while wearing different costumes. Join any mode and have a blast! Remember to collect diamonds during the free ride to unlock more items.

title: PaperWar.io
description: There are so many unexplored areas! Conquering them is the key to mastering the game. Expand your territory, eliminate other players who threaten your progress and aim to conquer 100% of each new map. Choose from 9 special skins to express your style!

title: Fish Out of Water!
description:
Dive into a thrilling adventure with Fish Out of Water, without ads or in-app purchases. A captivating game by Halfbrick Studios, the creators of Fruit Ninja and Jetpack Joyride. Launch a group of brave fish pals into the sky and over the ocean, helping them travel far and bounce as much as possible!

Experience remastered graphics and audio and enjoy a rebalanced crystal unlocking system for a more rewarding experience.

title: Phone Case DIY Run
description: Phone Case DIY Run is a very fun simulation game. What type of phone case do you have now? If you are interested in making a phone case, then come and join us to learn about the process! Collect the models, choose your favorite color for painting, then paste the picture and choose the pendant. Finally, the more phone cases you collect when you reach the end, the more money you get. Have fun!

title: Suika Kawaii Cat Merge game
description: The game is a fun, puzzle-based merging game where players control a dropper that releases animals onto the field. Players must carefully move the dropper to align and drop matching animals. When two of the same type collide, they merge into a higher-level animal. The goal is to keep merging and progressing to create new animals. Special buttons offer abilities like shaking the container or merging random animals, adding strategy and excitement to the gameplay.

title: Brainrot Hook Swing
description: Brainrot Hook Swing is an addictive physics-based platformer where players control the Brainrot swinging through levels using a grappling hook. With smooth animations, challenging obstacles, and fun physics mechanics, the game tests your timing and precision as you swing from one point to another, avoiding obstacles and making daring jumps to reach the finish line.

title: Candy Rain 5
description: Get ready for a delightful and vibrant match-3 experience with Candy Rain 5! The beloved Candy Rain series continues with even more sugary fun and challenging puzzles to enjoy.

title: Jelly-Belly. Make the Elephant
description: It is a puzzle like "Watermelon game" where you need drop animals in a container and try not to cross the top line. Animals of the same type will combine and create a larger animal. Merge the animals to create the biggest animal - Elephant.

title: Nuwpy's Adventure
description:
Nuwpy’s Adventure is a classic pixel-art platformer inspired by retro arcade games!
Help Nuwpy explore colorful worlds, collect coins, jump over enemies, and avoid traps.
Each level offers new challenges, hidden secrets, and a fast-paced journey full of charm and nostalgia.
Dive into the pixel world and enjoy simple yet addictive gameplay!

title: Wacky Strike
description:
This time you will choose who are you actually. Well, no. Who is the strongest! Girls, or boys! So, just build a lot of towers, and buy your cool enemy! Fight like the real hero and you will cope with it, just try it!

Are you a good fighter? Then this game is for you! Just pick a side, setup your troops, and fight against your mortal enemy, do you think that it is so easy?! Then march from your castle to the enemy castle claiming ground in between.

title: Slime Attack: Puzzle!
description: In this complete action, the play-heading playing you have to choose the right arrows and hit the corresponding slugs until it became too late. Calculate the time of shots, select colors and bring down arrows on top to protect your kingdom!

title: Find The Cat - Cat Search
description: Discover the exciting world of finding hidden cats in this original puzzle game! Look for cats on black and white backgrounds by tapping on them to complete levels. With each stage, you will unlock new places and receive unique challenges that will test your attentiveness and observation skills.

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Lost Adventure
description: Lost Adventure is a survival puzzle game where you guide a determined pilot through a strange, untamed land after a mid-air crash. Craft tools, mine resources, and solve clever challenges as you race to rescue scattered passengers. Your choices shape their fate—will you lead them to safety before the wilderness claims them for good?

title: Bridge Wars
description: Gear up for Bridge Wars, a mobile gaming epic blending creativity and strategy. Immerse in a world where tactical mastery meets artistic flair. Draw patterns, summon stickman defenders in 3 seconds, facing relentless enemy vehicles. Upgrade characters, navigate intense environments, and stop foes from breaching. Embark on a thrilling adventure, showcasing tactical mastery against relentless waves!

title: Block Digger
description: Dig, Click, and Get Rich! In Block Digger, every tap brings you closer to fortune! Smash stones, collect coins and crystals, and upgrade your mine to skyrocket your earnings. Unlock new mines, chase achievements, and build your mining empire. It's easy, fun, and totally addictive—start digging today! ⛏️

title: Wordmeister HD
description:
Create words in the English dictionary to score points. Drag and drop the tiles to form words.

Take advantage of bonus tiles such as double letter scores, triple word scores and more. How well-versed are you with the English vocabulary?

The highest score wins!

title: Nail Queen
description: Play Nail Salon Queen, the ultimate makeover and manicure game loved by US teens! Design beautiful nail art, run your own salon, and complete fashion challenges with glitter, polish, and gems. Perfect for players searching “nail salon game,” “manicure game,” or “fashion makeover,” this fun beauty challenge lets you style nails like a pro. With colorful levels, creative designs, and endless glam, it’s the best free nail game for fashion fans and students everywhere!

title: Aventador Vice Crime City
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate realistic traffic and monitor your fuel while exploring busy streets. Enjoy stunning morning city graphics, transforming the city into a spectacle. Pedestrians add unpredictability, and hitting them triggers police chases. Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Aventador Vice Crime City offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.

title: Slime Farm!
description: Farm Slime: Slime Farm Simulator is a relaxing yet addictive game where you drive a suction truck to vacuum up unruly slimes and turn them into cash. Cruise smoothly through gooey fields, slurp with satisfying precision, sell your haul to upgrade your truck and expand your farm into a thriving slime empire.

title: Candy Doll Dress Up
description: Candy Doll Dress Up is a wonderful fashion adventure! Step into a world of fashion magic, where you’re the ultimate stylist for your very own princess doll. There are tons of different styles of clothes here to help you create the doll. You can customize a doll from scratch—pick hair, make, and dress to scream your style.

title: Run Now
description: Dive into Run Now, where each step is a puzzle waiting to be solved! This game offers a unique blend of creative challenges, quirky humor, and addictive gameplay. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers alike, Run Now invites you to test your skills in a world filled with unexpected obstacles and entertaining surprises.

title: Find the Frog - Hidden Objects
description: Go on a relaxing and magical adventure in Find the Frog - Hidden Objects. In this charming hidden object game, you’ll explore beautifully hand-drawn black-and-white scenes and try to spot frogs hiding in plain sight. With each click or tap, the world around you lights up in color, revealing hidden surprises and playful details. Play for free on both mobile and desktop, unlock new levels, and collect unique frogs from all around the world.

title: 2 Player Mini Challenge
description: 2 Player Mini Challenge is an online casual game. If you want to play with your friends on the same device, or if you want to play alone against the AI, this is the game for you! This 2-player game collection features beautifully minimalist graphics that allow you to focus on going head-to-head with your opponent. The more participants you have, the more fun you'll have as you practice skills, react quickly, and interact with friends, relatives, and coworkers in a whole new way.

title: Find It Out Colorful Book
description: Begin a challenging yet relaxing casual game in Find It Out Colorful Book. It brings you into a colorful world. You will begin an adventure to find hidden objects. Choose your favorite mode like beach, city, zoo, etc. Each page is filled with color and mysterious numbers waiting to be discovered and unlocked.

title: Dino Ranch
description:
JON & BLITZ - IT’S VELOCI-TIME!
• Throwing the lasso to the escaped compies
• Dodging herds of ankylosaurus.
• Finding the naughty compies.
• Feeding Angus.
• Flying and dodging objects with Pteddy
• Moving the dinosaurs to the stable.
• Challenging the Trihorn Raptor to a race.
• Helping the compies to jump across the river.

title: Arrow Escape: Master
description: Solve funny brain puzzles by moving the arrow and finding the correct path. Each level challenges your logic, reflexes, and creativity in a light and addictive way.

title: RobyBox - Space Station Warehouse
description:
Your main task is to place boxes in their designated places to open doors and advance through the levels. Be on the alert! Aggressive bots will chase you. You can destroy them with a powerful arsenal including drill, disks, mines and rockets. Traps are scattered throughout the levels - use them to your advantage by luring the bots into dangerous areas. 
When you need a break from the intense gameplay, head to the warehouse where you can earn gold and solve Sokoban-style puzzles in peace.

title: Cool Girl Aesthetics
description: In Cool Girl Aesthetics, join Mia as she creates her ultimate trendy look! Start by customizing her Stanley cup with fun colors, prints, and accessories. Then, style her headphones, giving them a unique vibe. Next, design her manicure with cool colors, rings, and temporary tattoos for a stylish edge. Complete the look with makeup options like face stickers, colorful braces, and more. Dive into this fun, creative dress-up, and makeover game for endless aesthetic options.

title: Best Classic Freecell Solitaire
description: Welcome to FreeCell Solitaire! Dive into this classic card game where strategy and patience are key. With all cards visible from the start, plan your moves carefully to arrange them into the foundation piles by suit, from Ace to King. Use the free cells wisely to maneuver your way out of tight spots. Are you ready to tackle the challenge and clear the board? Play the Best Classic FreeCell Solitaire now and put your skills to the test!

title: Hit Knock Down
description: Hit & Knock Down is a fun casual game where you aim to throw baseballs. Shoot as many targets as possible. Test your precision, reaction speed, and throwing skills. You aim to hit the right targets in each level. The goals at the level are very varied, such as wood, stone, etc. Each level presents different targets. You should hit with a baseball.

title: Sprunki Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Sprunki Jigsaw Puzzle is a fun jigsaw puzzle game. You can select one of the fifteen images and then select one of the four modes (16, 36, 64 and 100 pieces). Select your favorite picture and complete the jigsaw in the shortest time possible! Have fun and enjoy!

title: Brainrot Mob Clash 3D
description: Welcome to the wild and chaotic world of Brainrot Mob Clash 3D. It’s a full-blown racing and fighting adventure. Dash through 3D obstacle courses, avoid deadly traps like spikes and spinning saws. Match and merge your stickman army. Crush enemy mobs in exciting action-packed battles. As you run, collect brainrot characters to increase your numbers and merge them to form powerful units.

title: Monster School 3
description: Continuation of the Monster School series from the creators of Noob vs Pro games. Teacher gave the school students a new challenge, this time the monsters will have to draw to survive!

title: Solitaire Farm Seasons 3
description: Solitaire Farm: Seasons 3, the highly anticipated sequel, continues the charming farm theme of Seasons 1 and 2 with incredible 3,400+ levels! Train your brain with diverse solitaire puzzles while enjoying country life. Explore new scenes and travel to new countries. Grow new crops such as Gooseberry, Foxgloves, Celery, Papyrus, Loquat, Prickly Pears, Berseem, and Blackberries. Enjoy stunning visuals and engaging gameplay in this delightful solitaire adventure!

title: Coin Merge Machine
description:
An unusual game in the 2048 genre variation! Merge similar coins to get more valuable ones! Try to reach the maximum without overfilling the glass!

Will you be able to get to the main coin of the game - 100 gold?

title: Pixel Path
description:
Pixel Path is a platformer with a non—standard plot.?
Get to the portal at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem... The floor may collapse, the spikes will move on you, and your character will grow to huge sizes. One wrong step and the game is over.❌
You will have to keep your sanity, expect surprises, show a good reaction and most importantly: do not get angry.?
The game also has a table of the best players who completed all levels faster than the rest.

title: Brawl Stars Sound
description: Listen to the voices and enjoy the visuals of the Brawl Stars characters. Start your sound-filled brawling adventure and enjoy a unique auditory twist in your gaming routine!

title: Shoot 2048 Hexa
description: Shoot 2048 Hexa is a fun and colorful puzzle game where you shoot hexagon tiles with numbers to make bigger ones. Aim carefully and match the same numbers to reach new values. The board slowly fills up, so think fast and plan your moves. Try to stay in the game as long as you can and get the highest score!

title: Clicker Hero
description: Click on the screen to defeat the monsters and earn gold in Clicker Hero. Spend your gold to buy and upgrade heroes that deal damage automatically. Then advance to fight tougher monsters that drop more gold. This game keeps going, even when you're offline, so come back later to earn and spend even more!

title: 3D Super Rolling Ball Race
description: Like speed? Love excitement? Then you can't afford to miss this awesome 3D Super Rolling Ball Race! It’s a wild, high-speed 3D platform game that will test your reflexes, timing, and racing spirit! The operation is simple but full of challenges, super suitable for those who like running and arcade-style. Control a rolling ball, navigate through tricky platforms, and avoid falling off!

title: Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D
description:
Welcome to the world of tanks of the game "Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D"! 
There are various tanks available in the game that can be controlled and pumped: T-60, T-54, T-70, IS-3, PLACES. Each of them has its own unique characteristics and capabilities. Choose your favorite tank and go to the battlefield!

title: Steal Brainrot Original 3D
description: Buy rare animals—from the entry-level Nubini Pitzanini to Tralalelo Tralal and Los Tralaleritos. Place them in your base, create ideal conditions, and start earning! Each animal generates income ? and opens the door to new opportunities. Grow your collection, improve your infrastructure, experiment with your team composition, and increase your profits. Want more income? Buy new, rarer animals and build your financial empire.

title: Going Balls Adventure 2
description: Going Balls Adventure 2 is a ball-rolling arcade game with a 3D game engine. Your main mission is to collect black balls and reach the checkpoint. Your side mission is to collect all coins on the platform. It doesn't matter if you don't fish the job. Before the level begins, you have a chance to try some free skins for you to decide on a favorite one.

title: Pop Culture Halloween Makeup
description: Immerse yourself in Pop Culture Halloween Makeup, where you can transform into your favorite icons. With a wide array of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, neck paint, tops, and accessories, you can create stunning Halloween makeup looks that will leave everyone in awe. Unleash your imagination, experiment with different styles, and become the ultimate makeup artist. Tap into the spirit of Halloween and play Pop Culture Halloween Makeup now to embark on a spooktacular journey!

title: Bottle Logic
description: Bottle Logic is a satisfying drag-and-drop puzzle where you move and organize bottles into the correct places with smooth, intuitive controls. Enjoy 500+ handcrafted levels that steadily increase in challenge—providing the perfect daily brain cardio—plus an endless mode for non-stop play. Perfect for quick sessions or long relaxing runs, this game is designed for puzzle lovers who enjoy strategic thinking and clean, minimalist visuals.

title: BFF Happy Spring
description: Welcome to the Bff Happy Spring games. Princesses Belle, Tiana, and Moana are best friends. They planned to organize a party to welcome the most adorable spring season. They already filled their wardrobe with a cherry blossom collection of outfits. Being a design expert join and help them to choose the best outfit for them. Have fun!

title: What a walk
description: Whatawalk! silly walking with wobbly legsWhatawalk! is a highly addictive classical game. Even if you've never heard of it before, play it just once and you'll be hooked.

title: Duck Luck
description:
Guide a lovable duck and his humorous friend and drop numbered blocks that merge when identical numbers come into contact, creating larger numbers that help clear the board. 
As you strategize and match numbers, you'll earn points. 
The goal is to accumulate the highest score possible by making as big of a number as you can.

title: Tied Up
description: Tied Up is a physics-based arcade survival game where you control a small ball tethered to a larger one by a spring. Use momentum and precise mouse movements to swing, evade, and counter waves of enemies. With only three lives per round, survival demands quick reflexes and smart play. Rack up high scores and push for a new personal best!

title: Blossom
description:
Blossom is a fun and relaxing puzzle game. You need to connect similar flower buds until 3 or more are connected. Then, the selected flowers will blossom, and your score will increase.

The variety of flowers will increase as you progress through the game, and the timer will speed up each time. Aim to reach your highest score!

title: Bloons Survival.io
description:
Bloons Survival. io is a fast-paced survival arcade game where you fight off endless waves of balloons!

Control your monkey hero, throw darts automatically, and pop incoming enemies before they get too close.
Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger, but stay alert — one hit can end your run!

How long can you survive?

title: Skate Hooligans
description: Help the little hooligans escape from the policeman who is constantly trying to catch them. Try to collect as many bonuses and coins as possible on the road, for which you can buy new coolest skateboards and amazing characters. And do not forget to complete funny tasks, because the number of points you receive depends on this!

title: Gold Miner Tower Defense
description: Gold Miner Tower Defense is a wonderful combination of tower defense, card strategy and upgrade combat. You will play as a brave miner protecting gold from enemies. Protect your precious treasures strategically with many unique defense towers!

title: Fun Obby Extreme
description:
Are you ready to experience an extreme game Fun Obby Extreme is a 3D parkour type game, little Obby needs you to help him jump across the platforms and reach the goal of each level.

Explore a sprawling city, level up and unlock new equipment, all while honing your parkour skills along the way!

title: Fury Tanks
description: Beyond the hills and forests, war waits in silence. When it starts, it’s you, your tank and the enemy in your sights. Build your armor, power up your cannon and let instinct guide your aim. When the ground shakes, make sure it’s because you fired first.

title: Float for Brainrots
description: Float for Brainrots is a chaotic water adventure game where you collect rare Brainrots across dangerous seas. Start with a simple raft, unlock powerful boats, upgrade speed and capacity, and explore deeper waters for better rewards. Manage your timer, avoid sharks, and use islands to survive. Play solo or with a friend in 2 player mode and build your ultimate Brainrot collection.

title: Move the rubber bands: Logic puzzle
description:
In this game you need to put the rubber bands in their places.
At the start of the level, rubber bands are scattered across the field. Your task is to move the cutters along the pins and place the cutters on the platforms of the corresponding color.
Your task is to solve logic puzzles. It won't always be easy to come up with a solution. Sometimes you will need to strain your logic and ability to navigate in space.

title: Dogs Spot The Differences
description: Immerse yourself in the charming world of 'Dogs: Spot the Differences,' a puzzle game featuring scenes filled with adorable companions. Challenge your observation skills, uncover subtle differences, and unlock new levels. With stunning visuals and escalating challenges, become a detective in a captivating journey of discovery and fun. Can you spot them all and become the ultimate enthusiast for your lovable companions?

title: Tail Gun Charlie
description: Tail Gun Charlie: An Epic War Simulator. Experience the thrill of flying an airplane in Tail Gun Charlie, the ultimate war simulator! Complete challenging missions and blast your enemies out of the sky! Use flexible controls to master the air combat! Are you ready for the adventure? Download Tail Gun Charlie now and have fun!

title: Fat Cat Life
description: In this game you will have a bunch of cats to choose from, a huge selection of hats and a variety of tasks. From the simplest to the most difficult.

title: Pet Tile Master
description: Enjoy a fun pet-themed tile-matching challenge in Pet Tile Master! Draw up to 9 tiles featuring adorable pets and match three identical ones to clear them. Be careful—if the stack fills up with 9 tiles, the game is over! Use smart moves to uncover hidden tiles and complete each level. Have fun with cute animals, relaxing gameplay, and tricky puzzles!

title: Offline FPS Royale
description:
Embark on a perilous journey in Offline FPS Royale, a brand new 3D shooter where you must fight for your life by eliminating every person you come across. You will get closer to finishing the map with every person you remove.

Kill foes from every angle in battle royale games as a stealthy assassin with the most captivating sniper experience.

title: Jet Fighter Airplane Racing
description:
Are you a fan of car traffic games & street racing? Do you like planes and the sky? We have something new to play! Try a plane flying game with different missions, improve your flying skills and become a true professional in racing piloting in Jet Fighter Airplane Racing!

Are you looking for exclusive aeroplanes?
• MiG-21 “Fishbed"
• McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II
• MiG-29 “Fulcrum”
• F-16 Fighting Falcon
• MiG-31 BM “Foxhound”
• F-22 Raptor
• SU-35 “Flanker-E”
• SU-47 "Firkin"
• SU-57

title: Hunt And Seek
description: Ready for a challenge of intellect and strategy? In Hunt And Seek, enter an adventure world filled with puzzles that will stimulate your brain as you search for hidden characters! This game offers endless fun and challenges, suitable for boys and puzzle enthusiasts! At the beginning of each level, an arrester is randomly selected. At the beginning of each level, a random arrester is selected to become a giant and start hunting.

title: 9 Blocks
description: Logical puzzle game with original gameplay. The goal is to fill all empty places in a chip merging with chips next to this one.

title: Garden Tales Mahjong 2
description: Welcome to the second instalment of the popular Mahjong game that combines Solitaire Mahjong gameplay with the beautiful theme of the legendary Garden Tales match 3 game. Garden Tales Mahjong 2 features incredible 250+ puzzle layouts, 'Quick Play' mode for instant action, 'Chapters Mode' to unlock new puzzles. The more puzzles you complete the more puzzles you unlock. Enjoy this captivating journey and start your Garden Tales Mahjong adventure today!

title: Mini Obby War Game
description:
Manage your little character and see him through the never-ending conflict in Mini Obby War Game, an action-packed 3D game set in a Roblox environment.

With over ten unique and challenging levels, this amazing game is within your reach. Keep sprinting to avoid being caught by the waves of enemy troops who will shoot you if they see you, and aim and fire at all adversaries.

As you defeat enemies, you'll find coins that may be used to unlock additional characters with unique abilities.

title: Hide Ball
description: Hide Ball is an addictive puzzle game where your mission is to protect the red ball from dangerous spiky enemies. Use the given blocks to build a safe shelter and hide the ball. Each level brings a new challenge — the constructions become trickier, and the enemies more relentless. Plan your moves, create a solid defense, and save your little hero!

title: Find Objects - Hidden Item
description:
Find objects on colorful maps with links and Easter eggs!
An interesting puzzle casual indie game in the genres of "Hidden Objects" and "Find the Differences"!

Embark on an exciting journey through beautiful 2D locations, where hundreds of hidden objects and riddles await you! Explore picturesque landscapes, mysterious cities and magical worlds to find all the hidden objects. And in the "Spot the Difference" mode, test your attentiveness by comparing two almost identical pictures!

title: Chaos Road Combat Car Racing
description: Chaos Road: Combat Car Racing plays like a shoot-em-up car shooting arcade game. With 3D vehicles on the ground, your mission is to defeat the final boss by collecting upgrade items and shooting down vehicles on the ground. Your vehicle will keep shooting automatically. Don't forget to collect the magnet to collect all kinds of items easily. To defeat the final boss, you need to avoid its bullets and keep shooting. Have fun!

title: Fireside Solitaire
description:
Fireside Solitaire is a cozy card puzzle that combines logic and relaxation by the warmth of a crackling fire.
Place cards in sequence — one rank higher or lower than the current open card — to clear all columns.
Think ahead: once the draw pile runs out, it can’t be reshuffled, and the game ends.
Enjoy calm music, soft light, and the comforting atmosphere of a winter evening by the fireplace.

title: Cleaning Simulator
description:
Cleaning Simulator is a very fun simulation game. Although this game is 2D, it restores the shape of objects in real life very well. This game has a total of 12 parts, covering sports cars, technological products, daily necessities, and other elements, which will definitely meet all your
expectations for cleaning games. Want to know more about this game? Come and try it!

title: Easter Eggventure
description: Welcome to Easter Eggventure! Embark on an exciting journey to find Easter eggs scattered throughout the beautiful spring landscape. Your mission is to discover the hidden Easter eggs and collect them all. Are you ready for this thrilling search game? Let's get started!

title: Steal Brainrot Eggs
description: Steal Brainrot Eggs is a competitive action game playable in both 1 Player and 2 Player modes. Players buy eggs from a central conveyor, carry them to their Base, and hatch random Brainrot characters based on egg rarity. Characters generate coins over time, allowing access to higher-tier eggs. Defend your Base from thieves or steal eggs and characters from rivals, customize your character, raise evolving pets, and take part in timed events across the map.

title: PopSortica
description:
PopSortica is a new chapter in Poppy’s adventures! Join the underwater SORTING voyage! Challenging yet relaxing levels await as you sort things out.
The rules are simple, but the difficulty increases with each new level.
Special obstacles and conditions will challenge your skills, while boosters will help you achieve the best results faster.
Dive deep with Mermaid Poppy and challenge yourself in this exciting sea sorting adventure!

title: Pumpking vs Mummy
description: Are you ready for a competitive game between the mummy and the pumpkin king on Halloween? Yes, someone has to win on Halloween! Team up with a friend and choose to be either the mummy or the pumpkin king. Collect as many flying pumpkins as you can! You can earn money by eating candies, and by gathering all the pumpkins, you can win the game. Catch the balloons and take them to the treasure chest. The one who collects and brings them back the fastest wins.

title: Last to leave circle Obby
description:
Last to leave circle Obby - is a dynamic online game in the style of Roblox, where only the most dexterous and persistent can win! Exciting obby challenges, dangerous traps and intense battles with other players are waiting for you. Going outside the circle means you're out, and the circle is getting smaller and smaller!

Tense obby challenges that will test your reaction and agility.
Roblox-style game with unique multiplayer.
Ability to compete with friends and players from all over the world.

title: Stickman Mega Boss: Battles!
description: Battle hordes of Minecraft mobs! Buy awesome swords and helmets, or unbox them from cases. Take on mega-bosses, unlock different modes, and earn leaderboard points to become the best in this game!

title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
description: Zombies have taken over the world! Unlock bases and deploy soldiers with unique weapons, each with stats like damage, fire rate, and reload speed. Soldiers must reload at the base before defending. Place them wisely to stop zombies within range. Defeat waves to earn coins, upgrade bases, and survive stronger hordes. Strategically choose soldiers to clear waves and save cities across the globe.

title: Jump Up 3D: Basketball Game
description: Jump Up 3D is a sports basketball game where you shoot to get that slam dunk, but the one hitch is you're doing it by jumping on a trampoline. Not your ordinary basketball game, this one promises and delivers the excitement! Take aim, bounce on the trampoline, and score baskets before your opponent. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, it tests your precision and unleashes your inner dunk master.

title: Alien Hunters
description: A fast-paced game where you will play a role of a robot hunter with a deadly dagger of light. With multiple enemies to kill, and a lot of challenging missions to complete, this game will take you on a captivating and thrilling adventure.

title: Agent Hunt: Spy Shooter Game
description: Step into the role of an elite hitman in this tactical first-person shooter. Complete covert missions with precision shooting, stealth infiltration, and strategic planning. Use advanced sniper weapons to eliminate targets across diverse environments from cities to enemy hideouts in this action-packed spy thriller.

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Capybara Suika
description:
Capybara Suika is a fun and relaxing food merge puzzle game starring adorable capybaras!
Inspired by the viral Suika Game, drop and merge food to grow bigger and score higher.
With colorful visuals, cozy vibes, and a tiny game size, it’s the perfect lite game to enjoy anytime!

title: Bouncy Barn
description:
Bouncy Barn is a lively farm simulation game where players explore the charming world of farm life. Care for cute animals like chickens, cows, and goats. 

Feed and nurture your animals to keep them happy, and in return, they’ll provide valuable produce like eggs and milk. Harvest these goodies and sell them at the market to earn profits for expanding and upgrading your farm. With vibrant graphics and engaging gameplay, Bouncy Barn provides a fun escape to create your dream farm!

title: Drive Ahead Sports
description: Want to begin a pixelated sports showdown like no other? In Drive Ahead! Sports, you’ll be behind the wheel of amazing vehicles, engaging in exciting soccer matches! Enjoy the rush of driving and the fun of the game! Use your skills to kick the ball, attack the opponent's goal, and aim for victory!

title: Rift of Hell-Demons War
description:
