description: Frog io is a 2D PvP game where players control frogs battling for dominance. Use your frog's tongue to devour other players and grow bigger and stronger! As you explore the map, eat fruits and enemy frogs to boost your size and power. But beware other players are after you too! Outsmart them, grow massive, and become the top frog in this dynamic and competitive io game.

title: Addiction Mini Solitaire
description: Mini version of Addiction Solitaire. Use empty spots to arrange all cards in color and in sequence from A to 6. You can move a card to a gap if it is the same color and 1 higher in value than the card to the left of the gap. You have 1 reshuffle. After the Ace you need to place a 2 and then ascending to 6.

title: Cars Derby Arena
description: Welcome to the world of Car Derby Arena! In this exciting game you can enjoy the unique experience of changing the color of cars, improving their performance, and manipulating gravity and weather conditions. Your goal is to become an invincible master of destruction, pump up your car and crush everything in your path. Embark on exciting missions, compete with other players and prove your skills in this epic Car Derby Arena game!

title: CloneUp - Stack Yourself
description:
CloneUp – Stack Yourself is a 2D pixel-art platformer where your greatest tool is… yourself!

Create clones, stack them, and use them as platforms to dodge spikes, reach new heights, and make your way to the exit door.

In CloneUp – Stack Yourself, you’ll use copies of the main character to reach platforms and avoid deadly obstacles.

title: Lazy Workers
description: The employees in the office have started slacking off and everyone is asleep. As the boss, you need to get the office back up and running. To do this, use your mouse and send employees to rows of desks. Move workers so they do not bump into each other. Your job will get a little more difficult with each level. If you cannot pass the level, you can use the option to skip the level.

title: Riot Village
description: Step into Riot Village, a thrilling browser-based adventure where your shooting skills and strategy are tested. Navigate 10 intense levels with AI enemies. Visit the market to choose from 6 unique weapons and equip up to 4 in your inventory. Switch weapons during gameplay to overcome challenges. The game features automatic character movement, letting you focus on aiming and shooting. Adapt your strategy as each enemy wields different weapons. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Jewelry Idle
description: What is the best jewelry? Of course, those made with your own hands! Create the best jewelry store! Design stunning pieces, attract discerning customers, and watch your business thrive in this sparkling venture!

title: 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw
description:
Sketch Your Path to Fight and Become the Ultimate Champion!

Step into the gladiator arena where only the strongest and smartest warriors survive! In 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw, you don’t just fight—you draw your attacks and dodges, controlling your gladiator’s every move with precision. Swipe, slash, and outmaneuver your enemies to claim victory!

title: World Solitaire -Tripeaks-
description:
It is TriPeaks, one of the most famous solitaires in the world.
Take a step to go up and test your brain and luck
How far can I clean it?

title: Word Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with a fresh twist on a classic with Word Solitaire! This addictive word solitaire blends clever word-building with strategic card gameplay, creating a unique solo experience. Find categories, reveal hidden words, and clear the board in increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for quick breaks or long sessions—relax, think, and master the art of words!

title: Hook Master Mafia City
description:
Hook Master: Mafia City is a casual puzzle game that combines puzzle solving, escape and collecting elements. In this dangerous city, you have to solve puzzles with your smart mind and use a cool grappling hook and swing skills, like a secret agent's flexible dodge, precise strike
and successfully escape the enemy hunt! There are two kinds of gameplay: grappling and swinging. Use the grapple for flexible movement, quickly across the city by snagging walls, buildings and so on.

title: Planet Hopper
description: Use your ship to navigate and jump between different planets across the galaxy, but be careful not to drift off into the vastness of outer space!

title: Stickman Prison Escape
description: Stickman went back to prison for committing a minor crime. It's time to find a successful way to escape from this cold, gray prison. Guards and other difficulties await you along the way. There will be a choice of 3 items that the guard brought hidden in the pumpkin. It's Halloween time and pumpkin will help Stickman successfully escape prison.

title: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon
description: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon is a relaxing and strategic idle game where players grow and manage their very own dairy business. Start by raising cows to produce milk, process raw milk then deliver the fresh milk packages to the market. Automate processes, upgrade your workers and warehouse to maximize efficiency and profits. Your goal is to build the ultimate dairy empire! Perfect for players who enjoy business simulation games.

title: Mahjong connect tiles
description: Mahjong Connect Tiles is a classic tile-matching puzzle game. We have combined the authentic charm of the traditional Mahjong Solitaire with modern convenience to create the perfect game for seniors and puzzle lovers of all ages. If you are looking for a relaxing yet intellectually engaging way to spend your time, this game is designed for you.

title: Car Vs Zombies
description:
Car vs Zombie is a fast-paced low-poly survival game where you smash through endless zombie waves with your car, build turrets, and defend your base from the undead horde! 
Get ready for non-stop action in Car vs Zombie, a low-poly, cartoony survival game where chaos meets fun!
Will you survive the apocalypse — or become zombie food?

title: Idle Drive: Merge, Upgrade, Drive
description: Welcome to Idle Drive: Merge Upgrade & Drive! Unleash your creativity, craft a unique vehicle for travels. Start with a basic car, enhance it using in-game currency earned by tapping. Accumulate funds for components like engines and tires. Merge parts for higher levels, boosting speed and power. Visit the garage to customize your car. Idle DriftDrive offers exhilarating fun and satisfaction of creating your own ride. Perfect for car enthusiasts and racing fans. Exciting moments await you!

title: CS: Chaos Squad
description: CS: Chaos Squad is an exciting 5v5 team-based shooter that demands tactical thinking, teamwork, and quick reflexes. Engage in fast-paced battles where you can purchase weapons and gear each round, allowing you to adapt your strategy on the fly. The ranking system tracks player and team performance, encouraging continuous improvement and competition. Fight for victory, build team synergy, and prove that your squad is the best on the battlefield!

title: Coloring by Numbers. Pixel Rooms
description: Immerse yourself in a game where the process of coloring becomes truly meditative. Create and decorate houses as a designer. Just touch the screen and the colors will match the numbers in the image. Forget about boring routine - now you are thinking about color combinations. For even more relaxation, a music player has been added.

title: Real Racing 3D
description: Immerse yourself in exciting racing! Play classic cars - step on the gas and win! Win championships and unlock new cars!

title: Cosmic Aviator
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey through the depths of the cosmos in Cosmic Aviator! In this pulse-pounding arcade-style game, you find yourself piloting a sleek aircraft that's trapped within a twisting and treacherous tunnel of unknown origin. Your mission? Navigate through the endless labyrinth of obstacles and hazards while collecting valuable power-ups to boost your score to new heights.

title: Stick Master Teleport
description:
Jump onto walls, throw knives, and teleport to your enemies ⚔️ to defeat them with a single strike.
Prove your ninja reputation by eliminating bad guys before they even notice.
Walk the tough path of a ninja to become a true ninja assassin!

title: Music Rush
description:
Music Rush is a 1-tap infinite and rhythmic runner where you play with iconic music stars and try to reach the highest stage in your career, while the song and the scenery evolve as you reach higher scores.

Try out 15 original songs and find out the genre you that fits you best!
- Electronic
- Rock
- Disco
- Pop
- K-Pop
- Classic
- Samba
- Latina
- Reggae
- Rap
- Medieval
- Dungeon
- Country

Try out amazing power-ups that affect your musical experience and much more!

title: Toy Claw Simulator
description: Toy Claw Simulator is a fun and addictive arcade game where you take control of a virtual claw machine to collect a wide variety of adorable toys! Carefully aim and time your claw to grab plushies, action figures, and surprise collectibles. Once you've stocked up your toy inventory, head over to the factory to sell them for shiny coins! Use your earnings to run the machine to use the crane to unlock new toys. It's a charming blend of skill, strategy, and rewarding progression!

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description: Step into the delightful world of Connect Puzzle Image, a game designed to tease your brain and sharpen your observation skills. Match and connect a variety of funny characters, tasty foods, and interesting objects as you progress through colorful levels. Easy to play yet delightfully challenging, this free online puzzle game offers hours of relaxing entertainment on both mobile and desktop devices.

title: Solitaire Summer: Klondike
description:
Ready to experience a summer full of Solitaire?
Finally, it's summer! Time to relax! What's better than to lay back, listen to the smooth tunes, enjoy the warm breeze coming from the sea and play some Klondike Solitaire.
Your goal in Solitaire Summer is simple, yet so addictive: Arrange all cards sorted by color in 4 stacks, from lowest to highest value. Can you remove all cards in the correct order and solve the Solitaire Summer puzzle?

title: Robbie: Become a Beast
description:
Transform into a wild animal and train to become the fastest and strongest in "Robbie: Become a Beast"! 

?? Improve your endurance, compete against rivals, and prove you're the best runner. ????‍♂️ Get pets to help you train and increase your chances of winning. ?? Enhance your skills and become faster and stronger with each victory! ?? 

Are you ready to be the ultimate beast? Train, compete, and win in "Robbie: Become a Beast"! ??

title: Sandstorm Covert Ops
description: Welcome to Sandstorm Covert Ops. As the leader of an elite team, your mission is to infiltrate a desert region controlled by a deadly terrorist organization. Navigate harsh terrains, gather crucial intelligence, and execute precise strikes to dismantle the enemy network.

title: Sprunki Space Challenge
description: Get ready to soar through the stars in Sprunki Space Challenge an intergalactic online adventure where brave kids take flight to save the galaxy. This wild space ride throws you into the cockpit of a zippy space rover where danger lurks in every asteroid and rocket burst. But worry not: Sprunki is here to lead the charge. It is all about timing, reflexes, and sky-high jumps that send you sailing straight into the action.

title: Choo Choo Spider Monster Train
description:
Welcome to the most terrifying train ride of your life!
Cho-Cho Scary Charles: Spider Train is a chilling open-world survival horror shooter where your only lifeline is a small yellow train armed with a machine gun and a whole lot of courage.
Face off against Charles — the monstrous spider-train hybrid that haunts a remote island, preying on unsuspecting humans. No one knows where he came from, but one thing is clear — he won't stop until he's fed.

title: The Hardest Puzzle Ever
description:
An Exciting Puzzle Game for the Whole Family! ?

Play together and train your brain every day! ?? Enjoy thrilling puzzles suitable even for the youngest players. With new levels added daily, there's always a fresh challenge waiting for you!

Have fun, improve your skills, and become a true puzzle master! ??

title: Memory Match Magic
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Memory Match Magic," a delightful casual game that challenges your memory and takes you on a magical journey of matching pairs! Immerse yourself in a whimsical realm filled with colorful cards, charming animations.

title: Stickman escapes from prison
description: New prison escape adventures welcome you! Your task is to play as a Stickman and find all the ways to successfully escape from prison. 10 different items to choose from are hidden in a secret place. Some items will lead you to victory, but many other items will lead you to death. Interesting animations and jokes will delight your attention. Check out all the items and enjoy the different situations in the zone.

title: Join Clash Color Button
description: Are you ready for a game of choices and surprises? Color Button is the game for you! You need to pick the right door and make it to the end safely. But be careful, each door can lead to a different challenge or enemy. You have to use your skills and strategies to avoid traps and obstacles. Teamwork is the key to success in this game. Color Button is an exciting game that tests your judgment and decision-making skills. Do you have what it takes to beat the enemies and reach the end?

title: Furry Kung Fu
description: Furry Kung-Fu & Babushka is a humorous fighting game with fun cartoon graphics, where controlling Cat or Babushka you need to inflict the enemy a series of hand-to-hand strikes, managing to dodge the sinister ball and sausage, which every second flies at you. Engage in epic hand-to-hand combat with park troublemakers. Earn achievements, get coins, unlock player skins! Will you be able to throw enemy sausage back at them? How long can you hold out? It's time to find out!

title: Capybara Coin Master
description:
Capybara Coin Master is a cozy yet addictive incremental tycoon clicker game where every flip counts!

Start small by buying your first coin and flipping it for income—heads mean profit! As your fortune grows, hire adorable Capybara Coin Masters to flip coins for you, even while you relax. 
Upgrade your coins to higher quality for bigger rewards, and unlock powerful Coin Mastery to boost your team’s flipping skills.

Flip. Upgrade. Profit. Rule the coin empire with your capybara crew!

title: Glossy Bubbles Challenge
description:
Dive into our bubble shooter! Burst bubbles, match colors, and rack up points in this addictive arcade game.

In the Glossy Bubbles Challenge, you'll encounter an incredibly colorful interface! The simple game mechanics combined with precise aiming create an atmosphere of complete control. Your task is to pop as many bubbles as possible with a single shot to achieve a high score. The ability to react quickly is crucial because the bubbles are relentlessly approaching!

title: Guivo.io
description:
Challenge the world in Guivo.io, a skill-based Match-3 battle arena playable instantly in your browser! Match pieces, shatter ice and outscore opponents in lightning-fast 2-minute rounds.
Climb our chess-inspired Elo ranking system based solely on skill, earn Trophies with each victory and see your name showcased in the winner's banner. Ready to prove you're the puzzle master?

title: Koi Fish Pond - Idle Merge Game
description:
An addictive idle merging game. Build your own Koi fish company and grow your business.
Release your Koi fishes into the pond and earn money every time they cross the finish line. Buy new Koi fishes (or collect them from the gift boxes), and merge the same level Koi fishes to upgrade into a new type. The higher-level of the Koi fishes, the more money you will earn. Use your earnings to buy upgrade packages in the Shop to help you make money faster!

title: Blue Girls Makeup
description: Experience the beauty world like never before with our Blue Girls Makeup game. It's time to unravel your creative side and weave makeup wizardry! This game allows you to dip your brush into a palette of possibilities, from stunning eyeshadow shades to gorgeous lipstick hues. Play it today and get the chance to experiment with different makeup techniques and spark your imagination. The Blue Girls Makeup game brings fun and fashion right at your fingertips. Dive in now!

title: Tank Sniper 3D
description:
Tank Sniper 3D: The Ultimate Shooting Game
Are you a fan of shooting games? Do you have what it takes to be a sniper tank driver? Then youll love Tank Sniper 3D - the action game that puts your skills to the test. Shoot your enemies with one shot from behind cover. Stay hidden until you strike with a surprise shot. Then, dodge their fire and hit as many targets as you can. How long can you survive? Find out now and play Tank Sniper 3D!

title: Mage's Secret
description: Combine monsters and increase your power by thinking every action. You have to meet monsters, complete more than 100 tasks and learn the secret of the magician.

title: Quizmania: Trivia game
description: Sharpen your mind across exciting levels. Answer a variety of questions from different topics and use strategic hints to guide your way. As you progress, the difficulty increases, offering a rewarding and challenging experience with every round.

title: Capybara Jump
description: Bounce into a cute stacking challenge with Capybara Jump! Time your taps to leap as wooden blocks slide in from both sides, building a towering platform under your capybara. Land perfectly to chain combos, trigger sparkles, and push your score higher before a mistimed jump sends you tumbling down.

title: Wipe Insight Master
description: Dop 3: Draw One Part is a free drawing online game for boys. Use your finger to draw and outline the shapes of the parts that the drawings need. Solve puzzles by using your powers of logic and lateral thinking as you work your way through a huge series of cute drawings that all have something a little bit wrong with them, it's up to you to work it out!

title: Looper
description:
Looper is a joyous and melodious music game that tests your sense of rhythm and timing. Get ready to start tapping your way through a colorful universe of beats and melodies! With hundreds of unique levels, Looper is the perfect game to soothe your puzzling needs.

As you progress, the constellations become more complex, and the beats more satisfying. But be warned, mistiming a tap could lead to an epic crash and burn - so make sure to bring your A-game!

title: Sticker Book Puzzle Color By Number
description: Discover Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number, a unique blend of coloring and puzzles! Match stickers, solve brain-teasing challenges, and create stunning masterpieces. Relax with calming artwork and enjoy the fun of adult coloring like never before!

title: Sprunki Mini Games
description: We present you a compilation of several games with the famous characters Sprunki. The first game is the classic Sprunki game but with an expanded orchestra, that is, with 9 singers. In the second game, you are presented with 10 pictures to color. While the third is a game of finding differences where you have 20 levels with 10 differences on each level.

title: Real Impossible Sky Tracks Car Driving
description: Real Impossible Sky Tracks Car Driving  simulator, stunts, and gameplay options keep it interesting. This game is great for racing, 3D car games, and extreme car driving fans. Multiplayer and internet games let you challenge friends and show off your track talents. ??️

title: Broken City Combat
description: Immerse yourself in the chaotic battleground of Broken City Combat, a fast-paced FPS set in a desolate urban warzone. As the city crumbles under relentless attacks, you are tasked with surviving the brutal onslaught while rescuing survivors and taking down ruthless enemies. Navigate through abandoned streets, derelict buildings, and multi-floor complexes, each filled with challenges and surprises.

title: Tile Connect Pair Match Puzzle
description: Match & connect tiles of same color & be the master of pair matching puzzle game. In this you have to find and match the same objects. There are different objects.

title: Daily Match
description: Connect tiles with a great number of pictures in pairs within the limited time. As you crush all the tiles on the board, you can win the level! Become a tile master level by level! Play faster and faster to train your brain and exercise the link technology!

title: Swim Good
description: Chomp your way through a swirling feast of worms while dodging deadly spiky firing urchins! Stay alive, keep circling, and see how long you can last.

title: Hexon Rush
description:
Hexon Rush is a time limited puzzle game with a little bit of sci-fi look.

Main goal in the Hexon Rush is connecting all the lines inside the hexagonal tiles before time runs out.  There are 600 levels with increasing size, difficulty and complexity.

Don't worry, you will have two types of helpers to solve these puzzles. Be careful when you spend them because they are hard to obtain.

title: Ball Paint 3D
description: Ball Paint 3D is a relaxing, simple, and fun game for kids, free online. You only have to find the balls of the same color within the limited number of balls given to you to pass the game, with beautiful 3D graphics to give you the best gaming experience. It's a battle of the brains, do you dare to challenge?

title: Snowboard Game​ Party
description: Begin snow racing thrill in Snowboard Game Party. It's a high-energy multiplayer ski sport challenge. In this adrenaline-filled winter sports game, you’ll join other players on dynamic ski tracks full of surprises. Flexibly control your hero and race against other opponents. While keeping your speed! Avoid snowballs, fences, sudden slopes, etc. Win races to earn points, unlock gear, and customize your style!

title: THE KULKA
description:
THE KULKA is a one-button bullet-heaven arcade game where your single shot evolves into chaos. Inspired by Flappy Birds, Vampire Survivor and Pattern Survivors: Bullet Hell. 

MUTATE YOUR BULLET. FLAP, EVOLVE, SURVIVE.

title: Doodle Dino Run
description: Doodle Dino Run delivers an addictive running adventure where you control a cute dinosaur, avoid dangers, and push your distance record farther every time you play. Featuring smooth side-scrolling gameplay, precise jump timing is essential to survive. Packed with action, this dinosaur adventure challenges your reflexes as the speed continuously increases.

title: Chicken shooter io
description: SUPER COOL SHOOTER game, in which you will plunge into exciting fights with chickens, roosters and chickens. Your task is to choose the best equipment and make full use of your shooting skills to defeat other characters in this feathered battle!

title: DayCare Tycoon
description: Are you ready to build your dream business empire and be a great babysitter in this money tycoon simulator ? Dive into the world of daycare games and experience the joy of managing your own thriving idle tycoon games. From welcoming adorable babies to creating a safe and happy environment, this game offers everything you need to grow your daycare business into a successful venture.

title: Stunt Multiplayer Arena
description:
Go solo in a free roam challenge where you can pull off incredible stunts like front and backflips. Navigate icy and dirt tracks as you push various vehicles to their limits.

In the multiplayer derby mode, choose your vehicle—whether it's a car, truck, or van—and engage in a fierce survival derby. Compete against all other vehicles in an intense, smashing battle. 

Jump into the action today and see if you have what it takes to rule the arena!

title: Halloween Store Sort
description: In Halloween Store Sort, match spooky toys and Halloween decorations by dragging them between shelves. Create sets of three to clear the shelves and reveal hidden ones above or to the sides of the screen. With many levels and increasing difficulty, each level has a time limit, so think fast! Use the shuffle button if you get stuck. Complete all levels to win and become the ultimate Halloween sorting champion!

title: College Girl Coloring Dress Up
description:
BFF high school fashion makeover: coloring book & cool dress up games for girls!
New college girls dress up game & coloring book is here for you! Dress up the most popular high school girls, create their whole look, paint and color. These cool coloring pages and clothes design features made especially for fashion girls. Begin total fashion makeover with our girl dress up games!

Design outfits like a fashionista: dress up, choose hairstyle, necklaces and other amazing accessories such as skirts and dresses. Select a color and click on the fragment you want to color, when the painting of college girl is created, start drawing and coloring, become BFF fashion clothes designer.

Take screenshots, save as wallpaper, and share cute coloring pages with your friends and family absolutely for free.

title: Royal Bubble Blast
description: Welcome to Royal Bubble Blast, where you'll be transported to a majestic castle to enjoy a royal Bubble Shooter experience! Featuring vibrant, handcrafted designs and a colourful, lively theme, this game offers endless, relaxing gameplay accompanied by a beautiful soundtrack. Play as a King or Queen in the most exclusive Bubble Shooter enjoyed by royalty. Dive into a world of colourful bubbles and endless fun. So, what are you waiting for? Join the royals and start popping!

title: Childcare Master Online
description: Get ready to become a parenting superstar in Childcare Master Online! This wonderful casual simulation game is all about playing the role of a top parenting expert. As soon as you start the game, you'll find yourself in a lively daycare center with adorable kids. What's your mission? Give them love and care! First, you need to create a warm environment.

title: Atomic Merge 2048
description:
Atomic Merge 2048 is a fast-paced puzzle game where you drop and combine numbered blocks to reach the legendary 2048 tile! Strategically  drop blocks which fall on to center , merge identical numbers, and keep the pile from touching the red orbit. Watch out — one wrong drop could be the end!
Perfect for fans of casual, merge, and puzzle games. How high can you score before the stack overflows?

title: Jenny's Math Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind with Jenny’s Math Puzzle, a fun and brain-boosting online game where logic meets creativity. Arrange number tiles to solve equations, unlock new puzzles, and sharpen your math skills along the way. Play on your phone or computer — every move counts, and every solution brings you closer to becoming a true math master.

title: Retro Street Fighter
description: Travel back in time with Retro Street Fighter, a side-scrolling fighting game that will make you feel nostalgic. This game features 2D-pixel art that gives it a classic look. You will fight your way through multiple levels, facing different enemies and showing off your skills. You can choose from seven levels of difficulty and challenge yourself. You will also have various moves to use in combat, such as punches, kicks, and blocks. But be careful, some enemies are tough and dangerous.

title: 3D Kid Sliding Puzzle
description: We've taken the classic sliding puzzle into a whole new 3D world. Kids will need to slide the scrambled blocks to rearrange them and complete adorable cartoon pictures, such as little animals, vehicles, and fairy-tale characters. The game features vibrant colors and lively 3D models that will immediately capture a child's attention. Not only does it provide hours of fun, but it also helps develop a child's logical thinking, spatial awareness, and problem-solving skills.

title: Speedrun platformer
description: A classic platformer with coin collection and jumping on monsters' heads. But if you complete the levels as quickly as possible, you can get into the leaderboard.

title: Bike Stunt Racing Legend
description: Bike Stunt Racing Legend is not merely a motorcycle racing but also a balanced stunt simulation game. Under a 3D game engine, you are required to ride the motorbike to the finish line in the first place. As long as you can keep high speed, the AI opponent will make mistakes and lose you. Don't be afraid of rolling ramps, pass the green arrows to speed up more easily. Keep calm and step on the gas!

title: Piggy Clicker
description: Piggy Clicker is a classic Clicker game, where you get to have Piggy as your pet and trough clicking buy him toys and such

title: Portal Master
description: Help Stickman in the fight against villains! Arrange the magic portals so that the bullet returns to the villain. Become a Portal Master superhero!

title: Noob Shooter: Gun Battle 3D
description: Noob Shooter: Gun Battle 3D is an exciting cooperative shooter created for true fans of action and intense battles. If you like games like CS, Warface and CoD, then this project will definitely not disappoint you. Join your team and engage in battle against opponents, striving for the main goal - to get as many kills as possible. The team that first reaches the required number of frags will be the winner.

title: Hardventure
description: In this colorful 2D game, you play as a little ninja navigating through tricky levels filled with hidden traps. Each world is vibrant and unique, but danger lurks around every corner with collapsing floors, deadly spikes, and bouncing bumpers. Stay sharp and quick on your feet to avoid these unseen hazards and make it through the levels unscathed!

title: Police Station
description: As the head of multiple police precincts, your mission is to boost the security rating in the district under your watchful eye. Begin your adventure by managing a modest police department, strategically hiring officers, and putting in the effort to cultivate a safer community

title: Space Survivor
description: Jump right into the action, fighting dangerous aliens and executing amazing maneuvers! Sharpen your weapons and skills, you will need them to last as long as possible.

title: School Love Story # 1
description:
Dive into an immersive anime visual novel about first love, friendship, and school adventures! Experience a unique branching storyline where every decision you make affects the outcome.

Why You'll Love This Game:
4 romantic routes with distinct characters – from a charismatic musician to a mysterious programmer!
Dynamic plot – your choices alter the story (with 10+ different endings!).
Stunning anime-style artwork and beautiful background music.

title: Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition
description: Relive 2024’s hottest fashion trends in Style Icons: 2024 Rewind Edition! From TikTok-inspired makeup to glamorous red carpet looks, this game brings together the best dress-up challenges of the year! Style iconic outfits, create bold beauty looks, and transform your favorite characters for every occasion—festivals, dates, holidays, and more! Are you ready to be the ultimate fashion trendsetter? Play now and own the style game!

title: Bubble Shooter Vintage
description:
Play the vintage classic - Bubble Shooter!

One of the most compelling bubble shooter games is available for FREE!
Aim your cannon, SHOOT and match three same color bubbles to pop your way to the highest score.

title: Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle
description: Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle is an action fighting game where you, as a mighty Ultrahero. Battle against waves of evil monsters in a 3D world. Every battle is a new adventure. Feel the perfect fusion of tower defense and nervous arcade action in this game. As a hero, you must not only fight off monsters in epic battles but also use tower defense tactics to protect your base.

title: Zip Zap
description: Step into the fascinating world of Zip Zap, a unique online physics puzzle game that blends mechanics, movement, and precision. Tap, twist, and control your way through clever levels filled with moving parts and intricate structures. Every stage tests your timing and creativity — can you reach every target? Play for free on desktop or mobile and enjoy a perfectly balanced mix of challenge and relaxation.

title: Sudoku Master
description: Sudoku by in8finity is a classic puzzle game with a sleek dark theme, offering a smooth and enjoyable experience. Flexible settings let you adjust the difficulty to match your skill level. With intuitive controls and eye-friendly visuals, you can focus on solving puzzles without distractions. More than just a game, Sudoku trains logic, concentration, and memory. Challenge yourself and enjoy relaxing, distraction-free gameplay!

title: Desert Rover Survival
description: Desert Rover Survival is an idle survival adventure set in a harsh desert world. Begin with a simple setup and slowly build your own desert rover, upgrading parts and improving technology to push farther into the wasteland.

title: Fishing Baron Real Fishing
description: Fishing Baron Real Fishing is a casual fishing simulator that offers a realistic fishing experience. Enjoy a relaxing and challenging fishing journey. Become a fishing master. Start a fishing adventure across various beautiful fishing locations. From lakes to oceans, you can unlock different areas to fish. Each location has unique fish species and environments.

title: Sliding Puzzle
description: A premium, modern Sliding Puzzle game featuring progressive levels, AI auto-solve, custom themes, and satisfying sound effects. Challenge yourself with 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 grids. Arrange numbered tiles in order by sliding them into the empty space. Perfect for brain training and logic improvement!

title: Cosmo Puzzle
description: Cosmo Puzzle is a colorful puzzle game about a robot who dreams of collecting a collection of minerals from all over the Solar System.

title: Kids Coloring
description: Children adore entertaining coloring activities, and this Coloring Game stands out as one of the finest free coloring books and painting apps designed for kids!

title: Spaces Solitaire
description: Use spaces to arrange all cards in suit and in sequence from 2 to King. You can move a card to a space or empty spot if it is the same color and 1 higher in value than the card to the left of the space.

title: Chicken Strike
description: Meet the new exciting third-person shooter - Chicken Strike! Here you will act as a brave chicken who fights with opponents in different conditions. Buy a variety of skins to make your chicken unique. Enjoy jumping like a real chicken. Get ready for intense battles and become a true chicken champion!

title: Urban Assault Force
description: Step into the boots of an elite counter-terrorism unit in Urban Assault Force, an intense first-person shooter that plunges you into the heart of urban warfare. The city is under siege by a ruthless terrorist group, and it's up to you and your team to strike back and save the day.

title: Save My Pet Party
description: Cute pets need protection, would you like to help them? Draw protection walls for bees coming from different locations in each level and stop them. In levels you find difficult, you can get hints or skip the level directly. You can play Save My Pet Party game in 1 Player or 2 Player modes.

title: Live Star Doll Dress Up
description: Discover the makeover world of fashion and fun in Live Star Doll Dress Up Games! Immerse yourself in an interactive magic princess universe! In this dress-up anime simulator, you're in charge. Dress up your doll in trendy outfits. Get creative with makeup and personalize your cute doll!

title: Merge Beasts
description: A fun and addictive merge game where you combine cute and quirky beasts to create stronger and rarer creatures. Each merge brings you closer to discovering powerful evolutions and unlocking new surprises. Collect coins, upgrade your beasts, and watch your monster city grow!

title: Number Domination
description: Number Domination is a turn-based strategy card game where players compete to claim tiles on the board using number cards (0-9). Create chains of three or more, match pairs, or make a "Perfect 9" by summing two cards to 9. Each successful move earns points and claims tiles. At the end, each occupied tile grants an extra point to its owner. Play in Face the Challenger or Face the Champion mode and win with smart moves. Think ahead, outplay your opponent, and dominate the numbers!

title: Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up
description:
In Idol Livestream: Doll Dress Up, you’re dressing up your doll and getting her ready to go live. Pick from different styles—she can look like a fairy, wear chill street clothes, or go for a beach outfit. When you’re done, she jumps on the stream and starts showing off her look.

You can mess with her hair, add makeup, and try out accessories. There’s also a battle mode where you go up against other players to see who styled it best.

title: Mahjong Masters
description:
Enter the world of Mahjong Masters, where classic Mahjong meets fast-paced tile matching! 
In this exciting game, players have 2 minutes to match as many Mahjong tile pairs as possible. 
Each round is a thrilling battle against a new opponent. 
Accumulate battle points with each victory to climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate Mahjong Master.

title: Huggy Mix Sprunki Music Box
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of Huggy Mix Sprunki Music Box. This music game is filled with energy and rhythm. Follow the beats, tap along to the music, and have fun with casual gameplay.You can choose three modes: health, ice, and bad man. You can make unique tunes that reflect your personality.

title: Idle PinBall - Merge Clicker
description: Welcome to an exciting mobile game for those who love to combine elements and enjoy simple but addictive gameplay. Minimalistic 3D graphics, dynamic combinations and the ability to play for free, even without an Internet connection are waiting for you.

title: Downhill Car Ride: Crash Test
description:
Put on a real destructive show!

Forget about safety, in this game you need to check how strong the dummy is. At your disposal is a huge pile of dummies, an abandoned town, an incredibly huge arsenal and complete freedom of action! In this game you can check what will happen if you crash a motorcycle at full speed into a house with dynamite or what will happen if you jump out of the car a second before the accident!

title: Strykon
description:
Strykon is a mobile FPS game with exciting missions and battles. Play different modes like Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Free-for-All, where your goal is to survive.
Choose from many weapons, like pistols, rifles, shotguns, and snipers. Each gun has its own style. Enjoy great graphics, realistic sound, and easy controls. Earn rewards with the Battle Pass to keep the game interesting. Whether you complete missions or fight enemies, this shooter is full of action anytime, anywhere!

title: Team Loyalty
description: Build your crowd and claim victory! In this addictive game, you begin with a single character, but things quickly escalate as you pass through numbered gates and grow your crowd. Dodge obstacles, expand your group, and outnumber your enemies to win. The largest and strongest crowd prevails — can you assemble the biggest one and emerge victorious?

title: Survival Sword Battle
description: Survival Sword Battle throws you into a ruthless sword-fighting free-for-all battle where a single hit means defeat. Fight to unlock all 10 character evolutions and boost your speed with each upgrade. Can you dominate the leaderboard and survive the longest?

title: Makeup Fruits
description: In Makeup Fruits, give your favorite fruits a stunning makeover! Apply makeup, add accessories, and create fabulous fruit beauty icons. Choose from a variety of makeup options, including powder, lipstick, and eyelashes. Take a "selfie" of your creation and share it with friends! Earn gems to unlock even more fun items and keep the transformation going!

title: Valentines Makeup Trends
description: If you're still seeking inspiration for your upcoming Valentine's Day look, then look no further Our social media influencers bring a selection of super sweet makeup looks that are going to impress your Valentine tonight. In the Valentine's Makeup Trends game for girls, you can discover the secrets of a sophisticated fantasy makeup look in candy colors. Play today and have fun!

title: Ramp Car Jumping
description:
A one-touch race, fly, crash game that sends you flying through the air in your car before you smash into everything in your path!

Ramp Car Jumping is the most unusual challenge you’re likely to face this year. 

You literally jump off a ski jump in a car!
Crazy speed
Insane smashes
Maximum heat 
And so many smashes, you’ll get crash burnout!

Challenge your friends to an ol’ fashioned smash off!

What’s the biggest crash you can imagine? Try now and watch it happen!

title: Spooky Halloween Hidden Pumpkin
description: In Spooky Halloween Hidden Pumpkin, you’ll explore haunted locations like creepy graveyards, abandoned houses, foggy forests, and more. Each level is uniquely designed with eerie Halloween-themed settings full of tricks and illusions. Your challenge is to locate 10 pumpkins hidden in plain sight within each scene. The faster you find them, the better your score!

title: Beat The Zombies
description: Beat the Zombies is a vertical action RPG blending strategy and adventure. Explore a dangerous plant-zombie world, fight through stages, and defeat all plant zombies in your way!

title: Christmas Blocks Sort
description: Blocks Sort Christmas Edition brings a cozy holiday twist to the classic sorting puzzle. All the blocks have turned into festive Christmas colors like bright red, pine green, frosty blue, and warm gold. They start mixed together in different columns, and your job is to sort them so each column ends up with just one color. The rules are simple, but the challenge is still satisfying. Think ahead, plan your moves, and slowly bring order to the holiday chaos.

title: Purrfect Puzzle
description: Purrfect Puzzle is an adorable cat-themed tile-merging puzzle game where players strategically place and combine cat tiles with different values to achieve higher scores. With relaxing pastel visuals, the game challenges players to think ahead while enjoying a cozy, heartwarming experience. Perfect for puzzle lovers and cat enthusiasts alike!

title: Blue Mushroom Cat Run
description: Catch the mischievous thief in Blue Mushroom Cat Run! A cunning thief has snatched your gold, and guess what? Unlock vibrant worlds and zoom through endless obstacles in this action-packed runner. From sun-kissed beaches to neon-lit night streets, every map offers fresh surprises and heart-pounding thrills.

title: Block Color Puzzle Blast
description: Immerse yourself in the explosive fun of Block Color Puzzle Blast, a thrilling puzzler where strategic block placement is key. Drag and drop vibrant blocks to fill gaps, unleash combos to earn massive scores, and experience the satisfying blast as completed lines clear the board, challenging you to reach new heights in colorful puzzle mastery.

title: Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker
description: To get started with Sigma Boy: Musical Clicker, simply tap on Sigma Boy to earn points. Use these points to purchase upgrades that boost Sigma Boy's abilities. As Sigma Boy evolves, he will move from the desert to new, more advanced environments, eventually embarking on a cosmic journey. Each level presents unique challenges, so keep clicking, upgrading, and evolving to help Sigma Boy conquer them all.

title: Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake
description: Dive into a world of sweetness with Tiny Baker Ocean Jelly Cake! Create a shimmering ocean-inspired jelly dessert using playful shapes and colors, then decorate it with sea-themed toppings for the perfect underwater delight.

title: Brainrot Boing Boing Merge
description:
Welcome to Brainrot Boing Boing Merge – a charming merge puzzle game where adorable creatures meet polished gameplay and juicy physics!

Merge. Match. Maximize
Satisfying Effects & Lively Details
Unlockable Skins System
Relaxing Yet Strategic

If you love satisfying merges, juicy feedback, and charming characters, this game is for you. Play now and see what creature you’ll create next!

title: Screw Jam - Fun Puzzle Game
description:
Remove screws in correct order to get rid of the boards. 
Match the removed screws and complete the level. 
Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: Hammer Master－Craft & Destroy!
description: Do you want to relax and smash everything you see with a huge hammer? In this free casual 3D game we have successfully combined the mechanics of merging, crafting weapons, destroying objects, etc. Click "Play" & relieve your stress by breaking all around!

title: Shoot The Bottle
description:
You’re at an abandoned gas station with really nothing else to do. Why not grab a couple rounds to kill time.

In this immersive 3D game, your goal is simple: shoot as many bottles as you can. With limited time, precision, and speed are key to achieving the highest score. 

Tap or click to shoot the bottles. Shoot fast, shoot accurate to get the best score!

title: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds
description:
Dodge and shoot to survive 15 seconds! Master 40 levels of arrow chaos in this fast-paced pixel art platformer! 

Dive into Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds, a thrilling 2D pixel art platformer where every second counts! As a skilled archer, your mission is to survive 15 seconds per level by dodging deadly hazards and strategically firing arrows.

title: Schoolboy Runaway: room escape
description: Step into the gripping adventure of Schoolboy Runaway: Room Escape, where strategy and mystery go hand in hand. A young schoolboy finds himself locked in a strange room, full of tricky puzzles and hidden clues. Help him think fast, solve each challenge, and escape before it’s too late. Play for free on both mobile and desktop and see if you can unravel the secrets of every room.

title: Daily Jewels Blitz Mahjong
description: Enjoy Daily Mahjong with a sparkling jewels twist! Play a unique layout every day, match dazzling gem tiles, and keep your streak alive to earn boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, and Torch. Track your longest streak and collect daily rewards as you match your way through beautiful designs. Miss a day? There’s a rare chance to recover it. Relax, match, and dive into the timeless charm of Daily Mahjong with a brilliant jewels theme!

title: Neon Gravity
description:
Defy gravity in this intense neon-soaked arcade runner! In Neon Gravity, your goal is to survive as long as possible by switching gravity to avoid deadly spikes, saws, and mines.

Master the timing to pass safely between rotating gears and trigger the "Perfect" bonus for massive points. As your score increases, the game speeds up, testing your reflexes to the limit. Can you unlock all 10 unique skins, including the Ninja and the Eye?

title: Survival On Raft Multiplayer
description: Begin an exciting survival adventure in Survival On Raft: Multiplayer. Have an addictive survival-adventure simulation on an island. Here, you'll be gathering various foods, stones, and other items. Collect ocean resources like wood, leaves and rare items. Sharks in the sea will attack your raft at any moment.

title: Block Up
description: Block Up Contrast is a minimalist arcade game where you need a moving block upward through an endless series of obstacles. The challenge is to avoid barriers of contrasting colors while collecting points. The game requires precise timing and quick reflexes as the speed increases. With simple yet engaging gameplay, Block Up Contrast offers an addictive experience for players.

title: Princess Valentines Crush
description: Welcome to Princess Valentine’s Crush game. Princess Elsa has a crush on Jack Frost. She Invited Jack to the valentine’s party. Both have a plan to do some makeovers and enjoy taking some photos to post on social media. Join and help the beautiful couples. Have fun!

title: Warfare 1942 - online shooter
description:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of World War II, where every battle is a unique fight for survival!
The game is designed for military enthusiasts and those who love intense online battles. It’s the perfect choice for players who prefer shooters with detailed gameplay, a variety of characters, and customization. Suitable for both seasoned fighters and newcomers.

title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 2 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Crazy Bike Stunts PvP!

title: Stickman Jump
description: stickman run at full speed, control stickman jump to avoid direct collision. complete each challenging and difficult level

title: Two Supra Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful supra. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Draw To Crush : Monster Game
description: Play the thrilling "Draw To Crush: Monster game" . Use your artistic talent to defeat evil creatures. sketch and destroy the monster and save animals and the good clown at the same time is your task, you have to draw the line that changes into a three-dimensional weapon to blast the monster.

title: Block Blast Jewel Puzzle
description: Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle is a vibrant block-stacking game that mixes calm strategy with thrilling speed. Fit jewel blocks to clear lines in Classic, Timer, or Level modes. Easy to start, tough to master, and super satisfying—compete worldwide and climb the leaderboard!

title: BAT!zo Runner
description: Become the cutest vampuuurrr bat! Fly, dodge, and collect mysterious red potions in BAT!zo - new addictive endless runner!

title: Bank Boom Tung Tung Sahur
description: Are you ready for a bank heist? You have 20 seconds to crack the safe! Compete with your friend — the first to open the vault wins. Smash the safe open and beat your friend to it. Hit your friend with a club to slow them down and win the race. The club is a powerful weapon. The fate of the game is in your hands. Strike fast and unlock the bank vault!

title: Lollipop Stack Run
description: Dive into a sweet adventure in Lollipop Stack Run which is a colorful parkour game! In this fun arcade game, keep running while collecting vibrant lollipops to stack your sweet tower. You need to be flexible and glide between various obstacles, making sure to collect as many lollipops as possible during the run.

title: Idle Hotel Empire
description:
Grow your hotel empire in this idle tycoon simulation game.

Construct different hotel floors to suit the needs of your customers. This includes construcing standard hotel rooms, cafe bistros, deluxe rooms, meeting rooms for corporate customers, vip rooms, infinity pools, gym and fitness rooms and of course, the bougee presidential suite.

Control hotel employees, move them up and down the elevators to move the cash, and finally CASH it in the reception office.

title: Chocolate Dream: Idle Factory
description: Play Chocolate Dream: Idle Factory free online and build your candy empire in a fast-loading browser game you can play instantly with no download and no install. Produce chocolate bars, upgrade machines, and expand smart production lines in a strategy experience that feels like a rewarding brain game. This unblocked game runs smoothly at school or home and is fully mobile-friendly. Optimized for desktop and mobile, it’s a free online game perfect for quick breaks or long, satisfying factory.

title: Army Fight 3d
description: Begin the nervous army battles in Army Fight 3D. Here you need strategic thinking and quick reflexes.In this fun action battle game, you aim to build a powerful army. Defend your base, and defeat the enemy. Start by creating and upgrading your army.

title: Blox Fruits
description: Embark on an epic adventure across the seas in Blox Fruits, a Roblox MMORPG inspired by the world of One Piece. Choose your path as a Pirate or Marine, master powerful abilities granted by mystical Blox Fruits, and strive to become the strongest player in the game

title: Hero Pipe
description: The hero began his journey for treasure and to save the princess, but the puzzles in front of the hunter trapped him. What you need to do is to connect the pipes in the right order, so that the hero can take the hidden treasure and save the princess away from the dragons, wolves and monsters safely.

title: Typing Adventure
description: Get ready for a fast-paced typing challenge in Typing Adventure! Type the words above each enemy to defeat them before they get too close. The longer you survive, the faster they come! How long can your fingers keep up? Battle endless waves and test your speed in this thrilling typing survival game!

title: Words Match
description: This catchy combo of word search and spelling bee lets you create thousands of words with different lengths. Try to improve your score while hitting the targets presented in every unique level, and upgrade your word tiles to keep progressing! Relax and train your brain at the same time - can you pass all the levels in Words Match?

title: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt
description: Bubble Shooter Crystal Hunt is an exciting endless bubble-shooting puzzle game where players must collect specific target bubbles along with rare magical crystals that appear among the bubbles. Aim carefully and match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear space while the bubble wall slowly moves toward the border line, increasing tension with every shot. Crystals are hidden within bubble clusters and must also be collected to progress and boost scores.

title: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue!
description: Pull the Pin: Fish Rescue! is a relaxing and addictive puzzle game with lots of interesting puzzles. You will see several niches in it. They will be separated by partitions. In one niche you will see a fish, and in another water. You will need to carefully study everything and pull the pin. Thus, you will open it and water will get to the fish.

title: Mutant run
description: When you are running on a track full of various obstacles, you need to choose to go through the mutation gate to evolve your body, gain the talents of specific animals, and clear the obstacles in the road!

title: The White Room 4
description: The White Room 4 is an immersive escape game that challenges your logic and problem-solving skills. Find yourself trapped in a hotel room and embark on a thrilling adventure to escape. Utilize the tools at your disposal, solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and crack passwords to unlock your path to freedom. Will you be able to conquer the puzzles and break free from this challenging escape experience?

title: Galaxy Carnage
description: Battle in space with countless enemies and their bosses coming in waves. Lots of weapons, lots of lasers, lots of explosions and effects. Upgrade the starship to the most powerful machine for exterminating alien invaders.

title: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek
description: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek is an exciting and fast-paced hide-and-seek adventure game set in a colorful yet dangerous rainbow world. Step into this thrilling role-playing experience, choose your role, and get ready for an unforgettable adventure.

title: Jigsolitaire
description: Step into a peaceful world of beautiful images made from gentle, carefully crafted blocks. Jigsolitaire is a game you’ll want to return to every day: it helps you unwind, disconnect from stress, and enjoy a small moment of calm just for yourself. Each level reveals a new scene - warm landscapes, charming cottages, delicate nature details, and quiet corners you’ll love exploring piece by piece.

title: Festival Vibes Makeup
description: Join Ellie in Festival Vibes Makeup, a vibrant game radiating the spirit of the summer festivals. Delight in creating neon, boho-Aztec, and grunge makeup looks as you test your makeup artist skills in this colorful makeup game for girls. Mix, match, and shine with stunning eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, and glitter eyebrows!

title: Zombie Mission Survivor
description: The zombies and variant creatures are coming over you in waves. It is time to defend yourself in this game! The heroes are armed with weapons but they need to improve them by earning some gold from the zombie destruction. Upgrade your armories, weapons, and earnings on each round and make your defense stronger. Play with your friend and defend your lands against the zombies together by 2 player game mode. Let the action begin!

title: Ball Sort
description: Ball Sort is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you sort colorful balls into tubes – can you solve the puzzle with fewer moves?

title: Two RX7 Drifters
description: Drift through 3 stunning drift tracks and show how well you can steer the wheels of a powerful rx7. Go head to head with your friend in a drift battle and see whose a better drift racer, customize your ride with stunning body colors, underglows and cool rims. Are you ready to showcase your drifting skills?

title: Two Stunt Supercars
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Trial Xtreme
description: Trial Xtreme is an exciting game in which you have to get a new experience from driving a motorcycle. Experience a sea of adrenaline while riding a motorcycle and passing 30 levels with dizzying and spectacular obstacles.

title: Draw Climber
description:
Funniest race you ever played ! Draw your legs to win the race!
Any drawing will make you run !
When you are stuck you can draw another shape to pass!

title: Banana Farm
description: Embark on Banana Farm, an engaging business casual game catering to cat enthusiasts. As a diligent feline entrepreneur, oversee market operations and recruit adorable cat workers to enhance efficiency. Cultivate bananas and various products while serving charming cat customers eagerly queuing up. Ready to launch your supermarket?

title: Block Builder Jam
description: Block Builder Jam is a physics-based puzzle game that blends logic with creativity. Your goal is to drop blocks and fit them into the outlined shape on the screen. Each block falls according to real physics, so precision and timing matter. As levels progress, shapes become more complex and demand sharper planning. With its simple mechanics and engaging challenges, Block Builder Jam offers a satisfying mix of strategy and experimentation.

title: Barbee Summer Vacation
description: Summer’s here, and it’s time for Barbee and her besties to enjoy their dream vacation! In Barbee Summer Vacation, you’ll help each character get ready with stylish warm-weather outfits, fun accessories, and fresh summer vibes. Whether it’s flowy dresses, sunglasses, or floral tops, it’s all about picking looks that scream sunshine.

title: Cube to Hole Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Cube to Hole Puzzle!
Get ready for an exciting and brain-teasing experience! In Cube to Hole Puzzle, your objective is simple: fill the colored cubes into their matching colored holes. But there’s a catch—limited space on the board and only a few slots to move the cubes forward. You’ll need to plan ahead and choose the right cube to move first. Strategize carefully to avoid blocking yourself and clear the board to progress through each level!

title: Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza
description:
"Restaurant Simulator: Burgers & Pizza" is an exciting cooking and business management game where you become the owner of a fast food establishment. Prepare delicious burgers, tasty pizza, and other dishes while building a restaurant empire!

Features:
Real-time cooking - fulfill orders, combine ingredients
Varied menu - burgers, pizza, fries, drinks & desserts
Business growth - open new locations, hire staff
Economic strategy - manage finances, increase profits

title: Fruit Candy Merge
description: Welcome to Fruit Candy Merge, where juicy fruits and sweet candies come together in a delightful merging puzzle! Combine matching candies to create delicious fruit combos and watch them burst with flavor. With addictive gameplay and colorful challenges, can you merge your way to fruity success?

title: Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve
description: Embark on a Brain-Twisting Journey with Screw Nuts & Bolts: Wood Solve, an exceptional wood puzzle game about nuts and bolts to test your IQ brain power. For nuts and bolts lovers who likes challenge and innovative gameplay, the right game for you - the ultimate puzzle game - is here.

title: Jump Girl 3D
description: Jump Girl 3D is an addictive casual jumping game. It's time to stack your own tofu towers and help the lively girl climb the delicious bouncy tofu trampoline tower. Beware of obstacles that appear from both sides and try to stand in the middle for a smoother and safer ride. Try to challenge every move and unleash the girl's acrobatic skills! Go, Tofu Girl!

title: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D
description: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D is an exciting and simple scooter game where you ride through challenging tracks filled with obstacles. Your main goal is to reach the finish line without crashing. As you play, you’ll need to dodge barriers, keep your balance, and react fast. You can collect coins along the way to unlock new scooters with cool designs. With smooth controls and many levels to explore, the game offers fun, speed, and tricks for anyone who loves action on two wheels.

title: Match Find 3D
description:
Are you a master player of finding games?Do you enjoy matching puzzle games?Come to challenge this addictive puzzle game - Match Find 3D!
Unique gameplay, a combination of collecting and matching, and well-designed levels that will keep you entertained.

title: Sheep vs Wolf
description:
Protect the sheeps by blocking the wolf's way.
Simply click on tiles to block it. Every time you make a move The Wolf makes a move. So, be careful for the tile you block!

title: Escape from the Portal
description:
"Your soul is trapped between worlds. The only way home is to activate an ancient portal... but only one can pass through."
Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld.

title: Crazy Bunnies
description: An exciting platformer about super bunnies in which you have to go through levels created in the style of Minecraft. There is a single and cooperative mode.

title: Hyper Nurse: Hospital Games
description: Get ready to navigate through the fast-paced world of healthcare, where every second counts. Your mission as a hyper nurse is to provide exceptional care to patients, manage critical situations, and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital. Get ready to put your multitasking skills to the test as you juggle multiple tasks and make crucial decisions in hyper nurse: hospital games.

title: Greedy Snake : Brain Hole Explosion
description: This is a level based puzzle game where players will transform into a greedy snake and challenge different levels.Players need to make flexible judgments and plan their movement paths reasonably in order to safely eat apples and reach the finish line smoothly, winning the level victory.
